with tears, said with joined palms, like a child speaking stammering words to his father: / Acyuta said: / “Formerly indeed, you intentionally granted him the five-faced [form], which is the sign of the Lord.
Therefore, forgive him today; make favor toward this Creator who is worthy of grace.” / Thus requested by Acyuta, the Lord, satisfied in the courtyard of the host of gods,

1.8.s:
ityarthito'cyuteneśastuṣṭaḥ suragaṇāṅgaṇe |
nivartayāmāsa tadā bhairavaṃ brahmadaṇḍataḥ ||
1.8.d:
इत्यर्थितोऽच्युतेनेशस्तुष्टः सुरगणाङ्गणे ।
निवर्तयामास तदा भैरवं ब्रह्मदण्डतः ॥

1.8.s:
athāha devaḥ kitavaṃ vidhiṃ vigatakandharam |
brahmaṃstvamarhaṇākāṅkṣī śaṭheśatvaṃ samāsthitaḥ ||
1.8.d:
अथाह देवः कितवं विधिं विगतकन्धरम् ।
ब्रह्मंस्त्वमर्हणाकाङ्क्षी शठेशत्वं समास्थितः ॥

1.8.s:
nātaste satkṛtirloke bhūyāt sthānotsavādikam |
brahmovāca - svāmin prasīdādya mahāvibhūte manye varaṃ me śirasaḥ pramokṣam ||
1.8.d:
नातस्ते सत्कृतिर्लोके भूयात् स्थानोत्सवादिकम् ।
ब्रह्मोवाच - स्वामिन् प्रसीदाद्य महाविभूते मन्ये वरं मे शिरसः प्रमोक्षम् ॥
1.8.m:
“O Brahmā, craving worship, you deceitfully assumed the position of Lord. / Therefore, may you have no worship, place, festival, and the like in the world!”
Brahmā said: / “O Master, be pleased today, O you of great majesty! O giver of boons, I consider the release of my head to be a boon. / Homage to you, the Blessed One, the kinsman, the source of the universe,

1.8.s:
namastubhyaṃ bhagavate bandhave viśvayonaye |
sahiṣṇave ca doṣāṇāṃ śambhave śailadhanvane ||
1.8.d:
नमस्तुभ्यं भगवते बन्धवे विश्वयोनये ।
सहिष्णवे च दोषाणां शम्भवे शैलधन्वने ॥

1.8.s:
īśvara uvāca |
arājabhayametadvai jagat sarvaṃ naśiṣyati |
tatastvaṃ jahi daṇḍārhaṃ vaha lokadhuraṃ śiśo ||
1.8.d:
ईश्वर उवाच ।
अराजभयमेतद्वै जगत् सर्वं नशिष्यति ।
ततस्त्वं जहि दण्डार्हं वह लोकधुरं शिशो ॥
1.8.m: patient with all faults, Śambhu, whose bow is the mountain!” / The Lord said: / “This entire world, without fear of a king, will not be governed.

1.8.s:
varaṃ dadāmi te tatra gṛhāṇa durlabhaṃ param |
vaitānikeṣu gṛhyeṣu yajñeṣu ca bhavān guruḥ ||
1.8.d:
वरं ददामि ते तत्र गृहाण दुर्लभं परम् ।
वैतानिकेषु गृह्येषु यज्ञेषु च भवान् गुरुः ॥

1.8.s:
niṣphalastvadṛte yajñaḥ sāṅgaśca sahadakṣiṇaḥ |
athāha devaḥ kitavaṃ ketakaṃ kūṭasākṣiṇam ||
1.8.d:
निष्फलस्त्वदृते यज्ञः साङ्गश्च सहदक्षिणः ।
अथाह देवः कितवं केतकं कूटसाक्षिणम् ॥

1.8.s:
re re ketaka duṣṭastvaṃ śaṭha dūramito vraja |
mamāpi prema te puṣpe mābhūtpūjāsvitaḥ param ||
1.8.d:
रे रे केतक दुष्टस्त्वं शठ दूरमितो व्रज ।
ममापि प्रेम ते पुष्पे माभूत्पूजास्वितः परम् ॥

1.8.s:
ityukte tatra devena ketakaṃ devajātayaḥ |
sarvā nivārayāmāsustatpārśvādanyatastadā ||
1.8.d:
इत्युक्ते तत्र देवेन केतकं देवजातयः ।
सर्वा निवारयामासुस्तत्पार्श्वादन्यतस्तदा ॥

1.8.s:
ketaka uvāca |
namaste nātha me janma niṣphalaṃ bhavadājñayā |
saphalaṃ kriyatāṃ tāta kṣamyatāṃ mama kilbiṣam ||
1.8.d:
केतक उवाच ।
नमस्ते नाथ मे जन्म निष्फलं भवदाज्ञया ।
सफलं क्रियतां तात क्षम्यतां मम किल्बिषम् ॥
1.8.m:
then removed the Ketaka from his presence to another place. / Ketaka said: / “Homage to you, O Lord! By your command my birth has become fruitless.
Make it fruitful, O Father; let my transgression be forgiven! / The remembrance of you surely destroys sin committed knowingly or unknowingly.

1.8.s:
jñānājñānakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ nāśayatyeva te smṛtiḥ |
tādṛśe tvayi dṛṣṭe me mithyādoṣaḥ kuto bhavet ||
1.8.d:
ज्ञानाज्ञानकृतं पापं नाशयत्येव ते स्मृतिः ।
तादृशे त्वयि दृष्टे मे मिथ्यादोषः कुतो भवेत् ॥

1.8.s:
tathā stutastu bhagavān ketakena sabhāsthale |
na me tvaddhāraṇaṃ yogyaṃ satyavāgahamīśvaraḥ ||
1.8.d:
तथा स्तुतस्तु भगवान् केतकेन सभास्थले ।
न मे त्वद्धारणं योग्यं सत्यवागहमीश्वरः ॥
1.8.m: “Wearing you is not suitable for me; I am the Lord who speaks the truth. / My people shall wear you; therefore your birth will be fruitful.

1.8.s:
madīyāstvāṃ dhariṣyanti janma te saphalaṃ tataḥ |
tvaṃ vai vitānavyājena mamopari bhaviṣyasi ||
1.8.d:
मदीयास्त्वां धरिष्यन्ति जन्म ते सफलं ततः ।
त्वं वै वितानव्याजेन ममोपरि भविष्यसि ॥

1.8.s:
ityanugṛhya bhagavān ketakaṃ vidhimādhavau |
virarāja sabhāmadhye sarvadevairabhiṣṭutaḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
vidyeśvarasaṃhitā
1.8.d:
इत्यनुगृह्य भगवान् केतकं विधिमाधवौ ।
विरराज सभामध्ये सर्वदेवैरभिष्टुतः ॥
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥
विद्येश्वरसंहिता
1.8.m:
the Blessed One shone in the midst of the assembly, praised by all the gods.

Homage to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

1.9.s:
nandikeśvara uvāca |
tatrāntare tau ca nāthaṃ praṇamya vidhimādhavau |
baddhāñjalipuṭau tūṣṇīṃ tasthaturdakṣavāmagau ||
1.9.d:
नन्दिकेश्वर उवाच ।
तत्रान्तरे तौ च नाथं प्रणम्य विधिमाधवौ ।
बद्धाञ्जलिपुटौ तूष्णीं तस्थतुर्दक्षवामगौ ॥

1.9.s:
tatra saṃsthāpya tau devaṃ sakuṭumbaṃ varāsane |
pūjayāmāsatuḥ pūjyaṃ puṇyaiḥ puruṣavastubhiḥ ||
1.9.d:
तत्र संस्थाप्य तौ देवं सकुटुम्बं वरासने ।
पूजयामासतुः पूज्यं पुण्यैः पुरुषवस्तुभिः ॥
1.9.m:
stood silently on his right and left sides with joined palms. / Having installed the Lord together with his family on an excellent seat there,
the two of them worshipped the one worthy of worship with sacred, worthy materials. / Material related to human enjoyment is to be understood as material of nature, of long and short duration,

1.9.s:
pauruṣaṃ prākṛtaṃ vastu jñeyaṃ dīrghālpakālikam |
hāranūpurakeyūrakirīṭamaṇikuṇḍalaiḥ ||
1.9.d:
पौरुषं प्राकृतं वस्तु ज्ञेयं दीर्घाल्पकालिकम् ।
हारनूपुरकेयूरकिरीटमणिकुण्डलैः ॥

1.9.s:
yajñasūtrottarīyasrakkṣaumamālyāṅgulīyakaiḥ |
puṣpatāmbūlakarpūracandanāgurulepanaiḥ ||
1.9.d:
यज्ञसूत्रोत्तरीयस्रक्क्षौममाल्याङ्गुलीयकैः ।
पुष्पताम्बूलकर्पूरचन्दनागुरुलेपनैः ॥

1.9.s:
dhūpadīpasitacchatravyajanadhvajacāmaraiḥ |
anyairdivyopahāraiśca vāṅmanotītavaibhavaiḥ ||
1.9.d:
धूपदीपसितच्छत्रव्यजनध्वजचामरैः ।
अन्यैर्दिव्योपहारैश्च वाङ्मनोतीतवैभवैः ॥
1.9.m:
flowers, betel, camphor, ointments of sandalwood and agallochum, / incense, lamps, white umbrellas, fans, banners, and fly-whisks,
and other divine offerings whose splendor surpasses words and thought; / with these, suitable for the Master and unobtainable by bound souls, the two worshipped the Master.

1.9.s:
patiyogyaiḥ paśvalabhyaistau samārcayatāṃ patim |
yadyacchreṣṭhatamaṃ vastu patiyogyaṃ hitadhvaja ||
1.9.d:
पतियोग्यैः पश्वलभ्यैस्तौ समार्चयतां पतिम् ।
यद्यच्छ्रेष्ठतमं वस्तु पतियोग्यं हितध्वज ॥

1.9.s:
tadvastvakhilamīśo'pi pāramparyacikīrṣayā |
sabhyānāṃ pradadau hṛṣṭaḥ pṛthak tatra yathākramam ||
1.9.d:
तद्वस्त्वखिलमीशोऽपि पारम्पर्यचिकीर्षया ।
सभ्यानां प्रददौ हृष्टः पृथक् तत्र यथाक्रमम् ॥
1.9.m: the Lord too, delighted, gave separately to the members of the assembly there in due order. / A great uproar arose there among those taking that material.

1.9.s:
kolāhalo mahānāsīttatra tadvastu gṛhyatām |
tatraiva brahmaviṣṇubhyāṃ cārcitaḥ śaṅkaraḥ purā ||
1.9.d:
कोलाहलो महानासीत्तत्र तद्वस्तु गृह्यताम् ।
तत्रैव ब्रह्मविष्णुभ्यां चार्चितः शङ्करः पुरा ॥

1.9.s:
prasannaḥ prāha tau namrau sasmitaṃ bhaktivardhanaḥ |
īśvara uvāca |
tuṣṭo'hamadya vāṃ vatsau pūjayāsmin mahādine ||
1.9.d:
प्रसन्नः प्राह तौ नम्रौ सस्मितं भक्तिवर्धनः ।
ईश्वर उवाच ।
तुष्टोऽहमद्य वां वत्सौ पूजयास्मिन् महादिने ॥
1.9.m:
Right there, formerly worshipped by Brahmā and Viṣṇu, / Śaṅkara, pleased, increasing devotion, said with a smile to the two bowed deities:
The Lord said: / “I am pleased today with the worship of you two, my children, on this great day. / Therefore, this day will become sacred and most exalted.

1.9.s:
dinametattataḥ puṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati mahattaram |
śivarātririti khyātā tithireṣā mama priyā ||
1.9.d:
दिनमेतत्ततः पुण्यं भविष्यति महत्तरम् ।
शिवरात्रिरिति ख्याता तिथिरेषा मम प्रिया ॥

1.9.s:
etatkāle tu yaḥ kuryāt pūjāṃ malliṅgaverayoḥ |
kuryāt sa jagataḥ kṛtyaṃ sthitisargādikaṃ pumān ||
1.9.d:
एतत्काले तु यः कुर्यात् पूजां मल्लिङ्गवेरयोः ।
कुर्यात् स जगतः कृत्यं स्थितिसर्गादिकं पुमान् ॥

1.9.s:
śivarātrāvahorātraṃ nirāhāro jitendriyaḥ |
arcayedvā yathānyāyaṃ yathābalamavañcakaḥ ||
1.9.d:
शिवरात्रावहोरात्रं निराहारो जितेन्द्रियः ।
अर्चयेद्वा यथान्यायं यथाबलमवञ्चकः ॥

1.9.s:
yatphalaṃ mama pūjāyāṃ varṣamekaṃ nirantaram |
tatphalaṃ labhate sadyaḥ śivarātrau madarcanāt ||
1.9.d:
यत्फलं मम पूजायां वर्षमेकं निरन्तरम् ।
तत्फलं लभते सद्यः शिवरात्रौ मदर्चनात् ॥
1.9.m: one obtains that fruit instantly from worship of me on Śivarātri. / This is the time for the increase of my piety, like the time of the moon for the ocean,

1.9.s:
maddharmavṛddhikālo'yaṃ candrakāla ivāmbudheḥ |
pratiṣṭhādyutsavo yatra māmako maṅgalāyanaḥ ||
1.9.d:
मद्धर्मवृद्धिकालोऽयं चन्द्रकाल इवाम्बुधेः ।
प्रतिष्ठाद्युत्सवो यत्र मामको मङ्गलायनः ॥

1.9.s:
yatpunaḥ stambharūpeṇa svāvirāsamahaṃ purā |
sa kālo mārgaśīrṣe tu syādārdrāṛkṣamarbhakau ||
1.9.d:
यत्पुनः स्तम्भरूपेण स्वाविरासमहं पुरा ।
स कालो मार्गशीर्षे तु स्यादार्द्राऋक्षमर्भकौ ॥
1.9.m: that time, my children, was in Mārgaśīrṣa under the constellation Ārdrā. / He who sees me accompanied by Umā in Mārgaśīrṣa during Ārdrā,

1.9.s:
ārdrāyāṃ mārgaśīrṣe tu yaḥ paśyenmāmumāsakham |
madveramapi vā liṅgaṃ sa guhādapi me priyaḥ ||
1.9.d:
आर्द्रायां मार्गशीर्षे तु यः पश्येन्मामुमासखम् ।
मद्वेरमपि वा लिङ्गं स गुहादपि मे प्रियः ॥

1.9.s:
alaṃ darśanamātreṇa phalaṃ tasmin dine śubhe |
abhyarcanaṃ cedadhikaṃ phalaṃ vācāmagocaram ||
1.9.d:
अलं दर्शनमात्रेण फलं तस्मिन् दिने शुभे ।
अभ्यर्चनं चेदधिकं फलं वाचामगोचरम् ॥
1.9.m: if there is worship, the fruit is even greater, beyond the range of words. / Since I manifested in the body of a liṅga on this battlefield

1.9.s:
raṇaraṅgatale'muṣmin yadahaṃ liṅgavarṣmaṇā |
jṛmbhito liṅgavattasmālliṅgasthānamidaṃ bhavet ||
1.9.d:
रणरङ्गतलेऽमुष्मिन् यदहं लिङ्गवर्ष्मणा ।
जृम्भितो लिङ्गवत्तस्माल्लिङ्गस्थानमिदं भवेत् ॥

1.9.s:
anādyantamidaṃ stambhamaṇumātraṃ bhaviṣyati |
darśanārthaṃ hi jagatāṃ pūjanārthaṃ hi putrakau ||
1.9.d:
अनाद्यन्तमिदं स्तम्भमणुमात्रं भविष्यति ।
दर्शनार्थं हि जगतां पूजनार्थं हि पुत्रकौ ॥
1.9.m: for the sake of being seen by the worlds and for the sake of being worshipped, my two sons. / This liṅga brings enjoyment, the sole means to enjoyment and liberation.

1.9.s:
bhogāvahamidaṃ liṅgaṃ bhuktimuktyekasādhanam |
darśanasparśanadhyānājjantūnāṃ janmamocanam ||
1.9.d:
भोगावहमिदं लिङ्गं भुक्तिमुक्त्येकसाधनम् ।
दर्शनस्पर्शनध्यानाज्जन्तूनां जन्ममोचनम् ॥

1.9.s:
analācalasaṅkāśaṃ yadidaṃ liṅgamutthitam |
aruṇācalamityeva tadidaṃ khyātimeṣyati ||
1.9.d:
अनलाचलसङ्काशं यदिदं लिङ्गमुत्थितम् ।
अरुणाचलमित्येव तदिदं ख्यातिमेष्यति ॥

1.9.s:
atra tīrthaṃ ca bahudhā bhaviṣyati mahattaram |
muktirapyatra jantūnāṃ vāsena maraṇena ca ||
1.9.d:
अत्र तीर्थं च बहुधा भविष्यति महत्तरम् ।
मुक्तिरप्यत्र जन्तूनां वासेन मरणेन च ॥
1.9.m: it will achieve fame as Aruṇācala. / And here will be many most exalted holy sites.

1.9.s:
rathotsavādikalyāṇaṃ janāvāsaṃ tu sarvataḥ |
atra dattaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet ||
1.9.d:
रथोत्सवादिकल्याणं जनावासं तु सर्वतः ।
अत्र दत्तं हुतं जप्तं सर्वं कोटिगुणं भवेत् ॥
1.9.m: Whatever is given, offered in fire, or recited here will become multiplied ten millionfold. / Even among all my holy sites, this holy site is greater.

1.9.s:
matkṣetrādapi sarvasmāt kṣetrametanmahattaram |
atra saṃsmṛtimātreṇa muktirbhavati dehinām ||
1.9.d:
मत्क्षेत्रादपि सर्वस्मात् क्षेत्रमेतन्महत्तरम् ।
अत्र संस्मृतिमात्रेण मुक्तिर्भवति देहिनाम् ॥

1.9.s:
tasmānmahattaramidaṃ kṣetramatyantaśobhanam |
sarvakalyāṇasampūrṇaṃ sarvamuktikaraṃ śubham ||
1.9.d:
तस्मान्महत्तरमिदं क्षेत्रमत्यन्तशोभनम् ।
सर्वकल्याणसम्पूर्णं सर्वमुक्तिकरं शुभम् ॥
1.9.m: filled with all auspiciousness, bringing liberation to all, and auspicious. / Having worshipped only me here, the Lord who possesses the liṅga, in the liṅga,

1.9.s:
arcayitvātra māmeva liṅge liṅginamīśvaram |
sālokyaṃ caiva sāmīpyaṃ sārūpyaṃ sārṣṭireva ca ||
1.9.d:
अर्चयित्वात्र मामेव लिङ्गे लिङ्गिनमीश्वरम् ।
सालोक्यं चैव सामीप्यं सारूप्यं सार्ष्टिरेव च ॥
1.9.m: residence in the same world, proximity, similarity of form, sharing of power, / and communion—these five are considered the fruit of rites and other means.”

1.9.s:
sāyujyamiti pañcaite kriyādīnāṃ phalaṃ matam |
sarve'pi yūyaṃ sakalaṃ prāpsyathāśu manoratham ||
1.9.d:
सायुज्यमिति पञ्चैते क्रियादीनां फलं मतम् ।
सर्वेऽपि यूयं सकलं प्राप्स्यथाशु मनोरथम् ॥
1.9.m:
All of you shall quickly obtain all your desires.”
Nandikeśvara said: / Having thus bestowed grace upon the humble Brahmā and Viṣṇu, the Blessed Lord

1.9.s:
nandikeśvara uvāca |
ityanugṛhya bhagavān vinītau vidhimādhavau |
yatpūrvaṃ prahataṃ yuddhe tayoḥ sainyaṃ parasparam ||
1.9.d:
नन्दिकेश्वर उवाच ।
इत्यनुगृह्य भगवान् विनीतौ विधिमाधवौ ।
यत्पूर्वं प्रहतं युद्धे तयोः सैन्यं परस्परम् ॥
1.9.m: then revived their mutual armies / that had previously been slain in battle, with a stream of nectar through his own power.

1.9.s:
tadutthāpayadatyarthaṃ svaśaktyāmṛtadhārayā |
tayormauḍhyaṃ ca vairaṃ ca vyapanetumuvāca tau ||
1.9.d:
तदुत्थापयदत्यर्थं स्वशक्त्यामृतधारया ।
तयोर्मौढ्यं च वैरं च व्यपनेतुमुवाच तौ ॥

1.9.s:
sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ ceti svarūpadvayamasti me |
nānyasya kasyacittasmādanyaḥ sarvo'pyanīśvaraḥ ||
1.9.d:
सकलं निष्कलं चेति स्वरूपद्वयमस्ति मे ।
नान्यस्य कस्यचित्तस्मादन्यः सर्वोऽप्यनीश्वरः ॥
1.9.m: No one else has this; therefore, everyone else is not the Lord. / First in the form of a pillar, and later in [personal] form, O two children,

1.9.s:
purastāt stambharūpeṇa paścād rūpeṇa cārbhakau |
brahmatvaṃ niṣkalaṃ proktamīśatvaṃ sakalaṃ tathā ||
1.9.d:
पुरस्तात् स्तम्भरूपेण पश्चाद् रूपेण चार्भकौ ।
ब्रह्मत्वं निष्कलं प्रोक्तमीशत्वं सकलं तथा ॥
1.9.m: the status of Brahman is declared as partless, and lordship as possessing parts. / Both are established in me alone, not in anyone other than me.

1.9.s:
dvayaṃ mamaiva saṃsiddhaṃ na madanyasya kasyacit |
tasmādīśatvamanyeṣāṃ yuvayorapi na kvacit ||
1.9.d:
द्वयं ममैव संसिद्धं न मदन्यस्य कस्यचित् ।
तस्मादीशत्वमन्येषां युवयोरपि न क्वचित् ॥

1.9.s:
tadajñānena vāṃ vṛttamīśamānaṃ mahādbhutam |
tannirākartumatraivamutthito'haṃ raṇakṣitau ||
1.9.d:
तदज्ञानेन वां वृत्तमीशमानं महाद्भुतम् ।
तन्निराकर्तुमत्रैवमुत्थितोऽहं रणक्षितौ ॥
1.9.m: In order to dispel that, I have arisen here on the battlefield in this way. / Cast off your pride and direct your thoughts toward me, the Lord.

1.9.s:
tyajataṃ mānamātmīyaṃ mayīśe kurutaṃ matim |
matprasādena lokeṣu sarvo'pyarthaḥ prakāśate ||
1.9.d:
त्यजतं मानमात्मीयं मयीशे कुरुतं मतिम् ।
मत्प्रसादेन लोकेषु सर्वोऽप्यर्थः प्रकाशते ॥
1.9.m: By my grace, every reality shines forth in the worlds; / the teacher's word, or valid means of knowledge, reveals it again and again.

1.9.s:
gurūktirvyañjakaṃ tatra pramāṇaṃ vā punaḥ punaḥ |
brahmatattvamidaṃ gūḍhaṃ bhavatprītyā bhaṇāmyaham ||
1.9.d:
गुरूक्तिर्व्यञ्जकं तत्र प्रमाणं वा पुनः पुनः ।
ब्रह्मतत्त्वमिदं गूढं भवत्प्रीत्या भणाम्यहम् ॥
1.9.m: Out of affection for you, I proclaim this hidden truth of Brahman: / I alone am the supreme Brahman, and my own nature is both with parts and without parts.

1.9.s:
ahameva paraṃ brahma matsvarūpaṃ kalākalam |
brahmatvādīśvaraścāhaṃ kṛtyaṃ me'nugrahādikam ||
1.9.d:
अहमेव परं ब्रह्म मत्स्वरूपं कलाकलम् ।
ब्रह्मत्वादीश्वरश्चाहं कृत्यं मेऽनुग्रहादिकम् ॥
1.9.m: Because I am Brahman, I am the Lord; my activity consists of grace and the rest. / Because of immensity and causing growth, I am Brahman, O Brahmā and Keśava.

1.9.s:
bṛhattvād bṛṃhaṇatvācca brahmāhaṃ brahmakeśavau |
samatvādvyāpakatvācca tathaivātmāhamarbhakau ||
1.9.d:
बृहत्त्वाद् बृंहणत्वाच्च ब्रह्माहं ब्रह्मकेशवौ ।
समत्वाद्व्यापकत्वाच्च तथैवात्माहमर्भकौ ॥
1.9.m: And because of impartiality and omnipresence, I alone am the Self, O two children. / All others are non-Self, individual souls only; of this there is no doubt.

1.9.s:
anātmānaḥ pare sarve jīvā eva na saṃśayaḥ |
anugrahādyaṃ sargāntaṃ jagatkṛtyaṃ ca pañcakam ||
1.9.d:
अनात्मानः परे सर्वे जीवा एव न संशयः ।
अनुग्रहाद्यं सर्गान्तं जगत्कृत्यं च पञ्चकम् ॥

1.9.s:
īśatvādeva me nityaṃ na madanyasya kasyacit |
ādau brahmatvabuddhyarthaṃ niṣkalaṃ liṅgamutthitam ||
1.9.d:
ईशत्वादेव मे नित्यं न मदन्यस्य कस्यचित् ।
आदौ ब्रह्मत्वबुद्ध्यर्थं निष्कलं लिङ्गमुत्थितम् ॥

1.9.s:
tasmādajñātamīśatvaṃ vyaktaṃ dyotayituṃ hi vām |
sakalo'hamato jātaḥ sākṣādīśastu tatkṣaṇāt ||
1.9.d:
तस्मादज्ञातमीशत्वं व्यक्तं द्योतयितुं हि वाम् ।
सकलोऽहमतो जातः साक्षादीशस्तु तत्क्षणात् ॥
1.9.m: In the beginning, to impart knowledge of Brahmanhood, the partless liṅga arose; / then, indeed to make manifest my unknown lordship clearly to you both,

1.9.s:
sakalatvamato jñeyamīśatvaṃ mayi satvaram |
yadidaṃ niṣkalaṃ stambhaṃ mama brahmatvabodhakam ||
1.9.d:
सकलत्वमतो ज्ञेयमीशत्वं मयि सत्वरम् ।
यदिदं निष्कलं स्तम्भं मम ब्रह्मत्वबोधकम् ॥
1.9.m: This partless pillar, which conveys knowledge of my Brahmanhood, / shall be my liṅga, since it possesses the characteristic marks of the liṅga.

1.9.s:
liṅgalakṣaṇayuktatvānmama liṅgaṃ bhavedidam |
tadidaṃ nityamabhyaryaṃ yuvābhyāmatra putrakau ||
1.9.d:
लिङ्गलक्षणयुक्तत्वान्मम लिङ्गं भवेदिदम् ।
तदिदं नित्यमभ्यर्यं युवाभ्यामत्र पुत्रकौ ॥

1.9.s:
madātmakamidaṃ nityaṃ mama sānnidhyakāraṇam |
mahatpūjyamidaṃ nityamabhedālliṅgaliṅginoḥ ||
1.9.d:
मदात्मकमिदं नित्यं मम सान्निध्यकारणम् ।
महत्पूज्यमिदं नित्यमभेदाल्लिङ्गलिङ्गिनोः ॥
1.9.m: This should be worshipped perpetually here by the two of you, O two sons. / It has my nature and is perpetually the cause of my presence.

1.9.s:
yatra pratiṣṭhitaṃ yena madīyaṃ liṅgamīdṛśam |
tatra pratiṣṭhitaḥ so'hamapratiṣṭho'pi vatsakau ||
1.9.d:
यत्र प्रतिष्ठितं येन मदीयं लिङ्गमीदृशम् ।
तत्र प्रतिष्ठितः सोऽहमप्रतिष्ठोऽपि वत्सकौ ॥
1.9.m: there I am consecrated, though I am unconsecrated, O two dear sons. / The installation of a single liṅga is said to bear the fruit of equality with me.

1.9.s:
matsāmyamekaliṅgasya sthāpane phalamīritam |
dvitīye sthāpite liṅge madaikyaṃ phalameva hi ||
1.9.d:
मत्साम्यमेकलिङ्गस्य स्थापने फलमीरितम् ।
द्वितीये स्थापिते लिङ्गे मदैक्यं फलमेव हि ॥

1.9.s:
liṅgaṃ prādhānyataḥ sthāpyaṃ tathā veraṃ tu gauṇakam |
liṅgābhāve na tatkṣetraṃ saveramapi sarvataḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
vidyeśvarasaṃhitā
1.9.d:
लिङ्गं प्राधान्यतः स्थाप्यं तथा वेरं तु गौणकम् ।
लिङ्गाभावे न तत्क्षेत्रं सवेरमपि सर्वतः ॥
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥
विद्येश्वरसंहिता
1.9.m: Homage to glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

1.10.s:
brahmaviṣṇū ūcatuḥ
sargādipañcakṛtyasya lakṣaṇaṃ brūhi nau prabho |
śiva uvāca |
matkṛtyabodhanaṃ guhyaṃ kṛpayā prabravīmi vām ||
1.10.d:
ब्रह्मविष्णू ऊचतुः
सर्गादिपञ्चकृत्यस्य लक्षणं ब्रूहि नौ प्रभो ।
शिव उवाच ।
मत्कृत्यबोधनं गुह्यं कृपया प्रब्रवीमि वाम् ॥
1.10.m:
Chapter 10
Brahmā and Viṣṇu said: / Speak to us, O Lord, of the characteristic marks of the five activities beginning with creation.
Śiva said: / Out of compassion, I proclaim to you both the secret instruction in my activities: / creation, maintenance, destruction, concealment, and also grace.

1.10.s:
sṛṣṭiḥ sthitiśca saṃhārastirobhāvo'pyanugrahaḥ |
pañcaiva me jagatkṛtyaṃ nityasiddhamajācyutau ||
1.10.d:
सृष्टिः स्थितिश्च संहारस्तिरोभावोऽप्यनुग्रहः ।
पञ्चैव मे जगत्कृत्यं नित्यसिद्धमजाच्युतौ ॥
1.10.m: The cosmic activity is fivefold, eternally established for me, O Aja and Acyuta. / Creation is the beginning of saṃsāra; its stability is considered maintenance.

1.10.s:
sargaḥ saṃsārasaṃrambhastatpratiṣṭhā sthitirmatā |
saṃhāro mardanaṃ tasya tirobhāvastadutkramaḥ ||
1.10.d:
सर्गः संसारसंरम्भस्तत्प्रतिष्ठा स्थितिर्मता ।
संहारो मर्दनं तस्य तिरोभावस्तदुत्क्रमः ॥
1.10.m: Destruction is its crushing; concealment is its departure; / its liberation is grace. Thus indeed are my five activities.

1.10.s:
tanmokṣo'nugrahastanme kṛtyamevaṃ hi pañcakam |
kṛtyametadvahatyanyastūṣṇīṃ gopurabimbavat ||
1.10.d:
तन्मोक्षोऽनुग्रहस्तन्मे कृत्यमेवं हि पञ्चकम् ।
कृत्यमेतद्वहत्यन्यस्तूष्णीं गोपुरबिम्बवत् ॥
1.10.m: Another bears this activity silently, like a painted figure on a temple tower. / The four activities beginning with creation cause the expansion of saṃsāra.

1.10.s:
sargādi yaccatuḥkṛtyaṃ saṃsāraparijṛmbhaṇam |
pañcamaṃ muktiheturvai nityaṃ mayi ca susthiram ||
1.10.d:
सर्गादि यच्चतुःकृत्यं संसारपरिजृम्भणम् ।
पञ्चमं मुक्तिहेतुर्वै नित्यं मयि च सुस्थिरम् ॥
1.10.m: The fifth is the cause of liberation, and it is perpetually steadfast in me. / This is observed by my people in the five gross elements:

1.10.s:
tadidaṃ pañcabhūteṣu dṛśyate māmakairjanaiḥ |
sṛṣṭirbhūmau sthitistoye saṃhāraḥ pāvake tathā ||
1.10.d:
तदिदं पञ्चभूतेषु दृश्यते मामकैर्जनैः ।
सृष्टिर्भूमौ स्थितिस्तोये संहारः पावके तथा ॥
1.10.m: creation in earth, maintenance in water, and destruction in fire, / likewise concealment in wind, and grace here in space.

1.10.s:
tirobhāvo'nile tadvadanugraha ihāmbare |
sṛjyate dharayā sarvamadbhiḥ sarvaṃ pravardhate ||
1.10.d:
तिरोभावोऽनिले तद्वदनुग्रह इहाम्बरे ।
सृज्यते धरया सर्वमद्भिः सर्वं प्रवर्धते ॥
1.10.m: Everything is created by earth; everything grows by water; / everything is afflicted by fire, and carried away by wind.

1.10.s:
ardyate tejasā sarvaṃ vāyunā cāpanīyate |
vyomnānugṛhyate sarvaṃ jñeyamevaṃ hi sūribhiḥ ||
1.10.d:
अर्द्यते तेजसा सर्वं वायुना चापनीयते ।
व्योम्नानुगृह्यते सर्वं ज्ञेयमेवं हि सूरिभिः ॥
1.10.m: Everything is graced by space; thus indeed should it be known by the wise. / To sustain these five activities, I have five faces.

1.10.s:
pañcakṛtyamidaṃ voḍhuṃ mamāsti mukhapañcakam |
caturdikṣu caturvaktraṃ tanmadhye pañcamaṃ mukham ||
1.10.d:
पञ्चकृत्यमिदं वोढुं ममास्ति मुखपञ्चकम् ।
चतुर्दिक्षु चतुर्वक्त्रं तन्मध्ये पञ्चमं मुखम् ॥
1.10.m: There are four faces in the four directions, and a fifth face in the center. / By austerity, O two sons, you have obtained these two activities from me:

1.10.s:
yuvābhyāṃ tapasā labdhametatkṛtyadvayaṃ sutau |
sṛṣṭisthityabhidhaṃ bhāgyaṃ mattaḥ prītādatipriyam ||
1.10.d:
युवाभ्यां तपसा लब्धमेतत्कृत्यद्वयं सुतौ ।
सृष्टिस्थित्यभिधं भाग्यं मत्तः प्रीतादतिप्रियम् ॥
1.10.m: the exceedingly dear fortune named creation and maintenance, from me who am pleased; / and to Rudra and Maheśa [have been granted] two other supreme activities.

1.10.s:
tathā rudramaheśābhyāmanyatkṛtyadvayaṃ param |
anugrahākhyaṃ kenāpi labdhuṃ naiva hi śakyate ||
1.10.d:
तथा रुद्रमहेशाभ्यामन्यत्कृत्यद्वयं परम् ।
अनुग्रहाख्यं केनापि लब्धुं नैव हि शक्यते ॥
1.10.m: The one called grace cannot be obtained by anyone at all. / All that past task has been forgotten by the two of you over time.

1.10.s:
tatsarvaṃ paurvikaṃ karma yuvābhyāṃ kālavismṛtam |
na tad rudramaheśābhyāṃ vismṛtaṃ karma tādṛśam ||
1.10.d:
तत्सर्वं पौर्विकं कर्म युवाभ्यां कालविस्मृतम् ।
न तद् रुद्रमहेशाभ्यां विस्मृतं कर्म तादृशम् ॥
1.10.m: That same task has not been forgotten by Rudra and Maheśa. / In form, dress, activity, vehicle, and seat,

1.10.s:
rūpe veṣe ca kṛtye ca vāhane cāsane tathā |
āyudhādau ca matsāmyamasmābhistatkṛte kṛtam ||
1.10.d:
रूपे वेषे च कृत्ये च वाहने चासने तथा ।
आयुधादौ च मत्साम्यमस्माभिस्तत्कृते कृतम् ॥
1.10.m: and in weapons and other attributes, equality with me was bestowed by us upon them. / Because of the absence of meditation on me, O two dear sons, such delusion came upon you.

1.10.s:
maddhyānavirahādvatsau mauḍhyaṃ vāmevamāgatam |
majjñāne sati maivaṃ syānmānaṃ rūpaṃ maheśavat ||
1.10.d:
मद्ध्यानविरहाद्वत्सौ मौढ्यं वामेवमागतम् ।
मज्ज्ञाने सति मैवं स्यान्मानं रूपं महेशवत् ॥

1.10.s:
tasmānmajjñānasiddhyarthaṃ mantramoṅkāranāmakam |
itaḥ paraṃ prajapataṃ māmakaṃ mānabhañjanam ||
1.10.d:
तस्मान्मज्ज्ञानसिद्ध्यर्थं मन्त्रमोङ्कारनामकम् ।
इतः परं प्रजपतं मामकं मानभञ्जनम् ॥

1.10.s:
upādiśaṃ nijaṃ mantramoṅkāramurumaṅgalam |
ūm̐kāro manmukhājjajñe prathamaṃ matprabodhakaḥ ||
1.10.d:
उपादिशं निजं मन्त्रमोङ्कारमुरुमङ्गलम् ।
ऊम्̐कारो मन्मुखाज्जज्ञे प्रथमं मत्प्रबोधकः ॥

1.10.s:
vācako'yamahaṃ vācyo mantro'yaṃ hi madātmakaḥ |
tadanusmaraṇaṃ nityaṃ mamānusmaraṇaṃ bhavet ||
1.10.d:
वाचकोऽयमहं वाच्यो मन्त्रोऽयं हि मदात्मकः ।
तदनुस्मरणं नित्यं ममानुस्मरणं भवेत् ॥
1.10.m: The continuous remembrance of it shall be the continuous remembrance of me. / The letter 'a' [arose] from the northern face, 'u' from the western face,

1.10.s:
akāra uttarāt pūrvamukāraḥ paścimānanāt |
makāro dakṣiṇamukhād binduḥ prāṅmukhatastathā ||
1.10.d:
अकार उत्तरात् पूर्वमुकारः पश्चिमाननात् ।
मकारो दक्षिणमुखाद् बिन्दुः प्राङ्मुखतस्तथा ॥

1.10.s:
nādo madhyamukhādevaṃ pañcadhāsau vijṛmbhitaḥ |
ekībhūtaḥ punastadvadomityekākṣaro'bhavat ||
1.10.d:
नादो मध्यमुखादेवं पञ्चधासौ विजृम्भितः ।
एकीभूतः पुनस्तद्वदोमित्येकाक्षरोऽभवत् ॥
1.10.m: the letter 'm' from the southern face, and the bindu from the eastern face; / the nāda arose from the central face; thus it expanded fivefold.

1.10.s:
nāmarūpātmakaṃ sarvaṃ vedabhūtakuladvayam |
vyāptametena mantreṇa śivaśaktyośca bodhakaḥ ||
1.10.d:
नामरूपात्मकं सर्वं वेदभूतकुलद्वयम् ।
व्याप्तमेतेन मन्त्रेण शिवशक्त्योश्च बोधकः ॥

1.10.s:
asmāt pañcākṣaraṃ jajñe bodhakaṃ sakalasya tat |
akārādikrameṇaiva nakārādi yathākramam ||
1.10.d:
अस्मात् पञ्चाक्षरं जज्ञे बोधकं सकलस्य तत् ।
अकारादिक्रमेणैव नकारादि यथाक्रमम् ॥
1.10.m: is pervaded by this mantra; it reveals Śiva and Śakti. / From this arose the five-syllable mantra, which reveals the entire universe,

1.10.s:
asmāt pañcākṣarājjātā mātṛkāḥ pañcabhedataḥ |
tasmācchiraścaturvaktrāttripādgāyatrireva hi ||
1.10.d:
अस्मात् पञ्चाक्षराज्जाता मातृकाः पञ्चभेदतः ।
तस्माच्छिरश्चतुर्वक्त्रात्त्रिपाद्गायत्रिरेव हि ॥
1.10.m:
in order from the letter 'a' onwards, and respectively beginning with the letter 'na'. / From this five-syllable mantra arose the mātṛkās in five divisions.
From that came the śiras, and from the four faces arose the three-footed Gāyatrī. / From that the entire Veda was born, and from that indeed crores of mantras.

1.10.s:
vedaḥ sarvastato jajñe tato vai mantrakoṭayaḥ |
tattanmantreṇa tatsiddhiḥ sarvasiddhirito bhavet ||
1.10.d:
वेदः सर्वस्ततो जज्ञे ततो वै मन्त्रकोटयः ।
तत्तन्मन्त्रेण तत्सिद्धिः सर्वसिद्धिरितो भवेत् ॥

1.10.s:
anena mantrakandena bhogo mokṣaśca siddhyati |
sakalā mantrarājānaḥ sākṣādbhogapradāḥ śubhāḥ ||
1.10.d:
अनेन मन्त्रकन्देन भोगो मोक्षश्च सिद्ध्यति ।
सकला मन्त्रराजानः साक्षाद्भोगप्रदाः शुभाः ॥

1.10.s:
nandikeśvara uvāca |
punastayostatra tiraḥ paṭaṃ guruḥ prakalpya mantraṃ ca samādiśat param |
nidhāya tacchīrṣṇi karāmbujaṃ śanai-rudaṅmukhaṃ saṃsthitayoḥ sahāmbikaḥ ||
1.10.d:
नन्दिकेश्वर उवाच ।
पुनस्तयोस्तत्र तिरः पटं गुरुः प्रकल्प्य मन्त्रं च समादिशत् परम् ।
निधाय तच्छीर्ष्णि कराम्बुजं शनै-रुदङ्मुखं संस्थितयोः सहाम्बिकः ॥
1.10.m: placing his lotus-hand gently upon the heads of the two who were seated facing north, along with Ambikā. / Pronouncing it thrice, he communicated the mantra, preceded by the instruction on yantras and tantras.

1.10.s:
triruccāryāgrahīnmantraṃ yantratantroktipūrvakam |
śiṣyau ca tau dakṣiṇāyāmātmānaṃ ca samārpayat ||
1.10.d:
त्रिरुच्चार्याग्रहीन्मन्त्रं यन्त्रतन्त्रोक्तिपूर्वकम् ।
शिष्यौ च तौ दक्षिणायामात्मानं च समार्पयत् ॥
1.10.m: And the two disciples offered themselves as the sacrificial fee. / Indeed, standing with folded hands before him, they sang praise to that very god, the guru of the universe.

1.10.s: prabaddhahastau kila tau tadantike tamūcaturdevavaraṃ jagadgurum ||
1.10.d: प्रबद्धहस्तौ किल तौ तदन्तिके तमूचतुर्देववरं जगद्गुरुम् ॥

1.10.s:
brahmācyutāvūcatuḥ
namo niṣkalarūpāya namo niṣkalatejase |
namaḥ sakalanāthāya namaste sakalātmane ||
1.10.d:
ब्रह्माच्युतावूचतुः
नमो निष्कलरूपाय नमो निष्कलतेजसे ।
नमः सकलनाथाय नमस्ते सकलात्मने ॥
1.10.m:
Brahmā and Acyuta said:
Homage to the one whose form is partless! Homage to the partless splendor!

1.10.s:
namaḥ praṇavavācyāya namaḥ praṇavaliṅgine |
namaḥ sṛṣṭyādikartre ca namaḥ pañcamukhāya te ||
1.10.d:
नमः प्रणववाच्याय नमः प्रणवलिङ्गिने ।
नमः सृष्ट्यादिकर्त्रे च नमः पञ्चमुखाय ते ॥
1.10.m: Homage to the author of creation and the rest! Homage to you who are five-faced! / Homage to the one who is the embodiment of the five Brahmans! Homage to you of the five activities!

1.10.s:
pañcabrahmasvarūpāya pañcakṛtyāya te namaḥ |
ātmane brahmaṇe tubhyamanantaguṇaśaktaye ||
1.10.d:
पञ्चब्रह्मस्वरूपाय पञ्चकृत्याय ते नमः ।
आत्मने ब्रह्मणे तुभ्यमनन्तगुणशक्तये ॥

1.10.s:
sakalākalarūpāya śambhave gurave namaḥ |
iti stutvā guruṃ padyairbrahmā viṣṇuśca nematuḥ ||
1.10.d:
सकलाकलरूपाय शम्भवे गुरवे नमः ।
इति स्तुत्वा गुरुं पद्यैर्ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च नेमतुः ॥
1.10.m:
Having praised the guru with these verses, Brahmā and Viṣṇu bowed down.
Īśvara said:
My two dear children, the whole truth has been told and shown to you.

1.10.s:
īśvara uvāca |
vatsakau sarvatattvaṃ ca kathitaṃ darśitaṃ ca vām |
japataṃ praṇavaṃ mantraṃ devīdiṣṭaṃ madātmakam ||
1.10.d:
ईश्वर उवाच ।
वत्सकौ सर्वतत्त्वं च कथितं दर्शितं च वाम् ।
जपतं प्रणवं मन्त्रं देवीदिष्टं मदात्मकम् ॥

1.10.s:
jñānaṃ ca susthiraṃ bhāgyaṃ sarvaṃ bhavati śāśvatam |
ārdrāyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ tajjapyaṃ tvakṣayaṃ bhavet ||
1.10.d:
ज्ञानं च सुस्थिरं भाग्यं सर्वं भवति शाश्वतम् ।
आर्द्रायां च चतुर्दश्यां तज्जप्यं त्वक्षयं भवेत् ॥
1.10.m:
Recite the mantra of the syllable Oṃ, taught by the Goddess, which is of my own nature. / Knowledge becomes firmly established, and all fortune becomes eternal.
Its recitation on Ārdrā and on the fourteenth [lunar day] becomes imperishable. / On the great Ārdrā according to the sun's course, a single [recitation] becomes multiplied a crore of times.

1.10.s:
sūryagatyā mahārdrāyāmekaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet |
mṛgaśīrṣāntimo bhāgaḥ punarvasvādimastathā ||
1.10.d:
सूर्यगत्या महार्द्रायामेकं कोटिगुणं भवेत् ।
मृगशीर्षान्तिमो भागः पुनर्वस्वादिमस्तथा ॥

1.10.s:
ārdrāsamaṃ sadā jñeyaṃ pūjāhomāditarpaṇe |
darśanaṃ tu prabhāte ca prātaḥsaṅgavakālayoḥ ||
1.10.d:
आर्द्रासमं सदा ज्ञेयं पूजाहोमादितर्पणे ।
दर्शनं तु प्रभाते च प्रातःसङ्गवकालयोः ॥

1.10.s:
caturdaśī tathā grāhyā niśīthavyāpinī bhavet |
pradoṣavyāpinī caiva parayuktā praśasyate ||
1.10.d:
चतुर्दशी तथा ग्राह्या निशीथव्यापिनी भवेत् ।
प्रदोषव्यापिनी चैव परयुक्ता प्रशस्यते ॥
1.10.m: The vision [is to be had] at dawn and at the times of morning and forenoon. / The fourteenth day should be observed such that it extends over midnight.

1.10.s:
liṅgaṃ veraṃ ca me tulyaṃ yajatāṃ liṅgamuttamam |
tasmālliṅgaṃ paraṃ pūjyaṃ verādapi mumukṣubhiḥ ||
1.10.d:
लिङ्गं वेरं च मे तुल्यं यजतां लिङ्गमुत्तमम् ।
तस्माल्लिङ्गं परं पूज्यं वेरादपि मुमुक्षुभिः ॥

1.10.s:
liṅgamoṅkāramantreṇa veraṃ pañcākṣareṇa tu |
svayameva hi saddravyaiḥ pratiṣṭhāpyaṃ parairapi ||
1.10.d:
लिङ्गमोङ्कारमन्त्रेण वेरं पञ्चाक्षरेण तु ।
स्वयमेव हि सद्द्रव्यैः प्रतिष्ठाप्यं परैरपि ॥

1.10.s:
pūjayedupacāraiśca matpadaṃ sulabhaṃ bhavet |
iti śāsya tathā śiṣyau tatraivāntarhitaḥ śivaḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
vidyeśvarasaṃhitā
1.10.d:
पूजयेदुपचारैश्च मत्पदं सुलभं भवेत् ।
इति शास्य तथा शिष्यौ तत्रैवान्तर्हितः शिवः ॥
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥
विद्येश्वरसंहिता
1.10.m:
One should install it oneself with materials, or through others, / and worship it with offerings; then my abode becomes easily attained.

Homage to the venerable Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

1.11.s:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kathaṃ liṅgaṃ pratiṣṭhāpyaṃ kathaṃ vā tasya lakṣaṇam |
kathaṃ vā tatsamabhyarcyaṃ deśe kāle ca kena hi ||
1.11.d:
ऋषय ऊचुः
कथं लिङ्गं प्रतिष्ठाप्यं कथं वा तस्य लक्षणम् ।
कथं वा तत्समभ्यर्च्यं देशे काले च केन हि ॥
1.11.m:
And how is it to be worshipped, in what place, at what time, and indeed by what means?
Sūta said:
I shall explain for your sake; understand with attention.

1.11.s:
sūta uvāca |
yuṣmadarthaṃ pravakṣyāmi buddhyatāmavadhānataḥ |
anukūle śubhe kāle puṇye tīrthe taṭe tathā ||
1.11.d:
सूत उवाच ।
युष्मदर्थं प्रवक्ष्यामि बुद्ध्यतामवधानतः ।
अनुकूले शुभे काले पुण्ये तीर्थे तटे तथा ॥

1.11.s:
yatheṣṭaṃ liṅgamāropyaṃ yatra syānnityamarcanam |
pārthivena tathāpyena taijasena yathāruci ||
1.11.d:
यथेष्टं लिङ्गमारोप्यं यत्र स्यान्नित्यमर्चनम् ।
पार्थिवेन तथाप्येन तैजसेन यथारुचि ॥

1.11.s:
kalpakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ liṅgaṃ pūjāphalaṃ labhet |
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sadyaḥ pūjāphalapradam ||
1.11.d:
कल्पक्षणसंयुक्तं लिङ्गं पूजाफलं लभेत् ।
सर्वलक्षणसंयुक्तं सद्यः पूजाफलप्रदम् ॥
1.11.m: Endowed with all characteristics, it immediately grants the fruit of worship. / In a movable [liṅga], a small one is preferred; in a stationary one, a large one indeed.

1.11.s:
care viśiṣyate sūkṣmaṃ sthāvare sthūlameva hi |
salakṣaṇaṃ sapīṭhaṃ ca sthāpayecchivanirmitam ||
1.11.d:
चरे विशिष्यते सूक्ष्मं स्थावरे स्थूलमेव हि ।
सलक्षणं सपीठं च स्थापयेच्छिवनिर्मितम् ॥
1.11.m: One should install a liṅga fashioned for Śiva, endowed with characteristics and with a pedestal, / circular, square, or triangular,

1.11.s:
maṇḍalaṃ caturasraṃ vā trikoṇamathavā tathā |
khaṭvāṅgavanmadhyasūkṣmaṃ liṅgapīṭhaṃ mahāphalam ||
1.11.d:
मण्डलं चतुरस्रं वा त्रिकोणमथवा तथा ।
खट्वाङ्गवन्मध्यसूक्ष्मं लिङ्गपीठं महाफलम् ॥

1.11.s:
prathamaṃ mṛcchilādibhyo liṅgaṃ lohādibhiḥ kṛtam |
yena liṅgaṃ tena pīṭhaṃ sthāvare hi viśiṣyate ||
1.11.d:
प्रथमं मृच्छिलादिभ्यो लिङ्गं लोहादिभिः कृतम् ।
येन लिङ्गं तेन पीठं स्थावरे हि विशिष्यते ॥

1.11.s:
liṅgaṃ pīṭhaṃ care tvekaṃ liṅgaṃ bāṇakṛtaṃ vinā |
liṅgapramāṇaṃ kartṝṇāṃ dvādaśāṅgulamuttamam ||
1.11.d:
लिङ्गं पीठं चरे त्वेकं लिङ्गं बाणकृतं विना ।
लिङ्गप्रमाणं कर्तॄणां द्वादशाङ्गुलमुत्तमम् ॥

1.11.s:
nyūnaṃ cetphalamalpaṃ syādadhikaṃ naiva duṣyate |
karturekāṅgulanyūnaṃ care'pi ca tathaiva hi ||
1.11.d:
न्यूनं चेत्फलमल्पं स्यादधिकं नैव दुष्यते ।
कर्तुरेकाङ्गुलन्यूनं चरेऽपि च तथैव हि ॥
1.11.m: The best measure of the liṅga for makers is twelve fingers. / If less, the fruit will be small; if greater, it is not at all faulted.

1.11.s:
ādau vimānaṃ śilpena kāryaṃ devagaṇairyutam |
tatra garbhagṛhe ramye dṛḍhe darpaṇasannibhe ||
1.11.d:
आदौ विमानं शिल्पेन कार्यं देवगणैर्युतम् ।
तत्र गर्भगृहे रम्ये दृढे दर्पणसन्निभे ॥

1.11.s:
bhūṣite navaratnaiśca digdvāre ca pradhānake |
nīlaṃ raktaṃ ca vaiḍūryaṃ śyāmaṃ mārakataṃ tathā ||
1.11.d:
भूषिते नवरत्नैश्च दिग्द्वारे च प्रधानके ।
नीलं रक्तं च वैडूर्यं श्यामं मारकतं तथा ॥
1.11.m: sapphire, ruby, cat's-eye, emerald, and dark gem, / pearl, coral, hessonite, and diamond—these are the nine gems.

1.11.s:
muktāpravālagomedavajrāṇi navaratnakam |
madhye liṅgaṃ mahad dravyaṃ niḥkṣipetsahavaidike ||
1.11.d:
मुक्ताप्रवालगोमेदवज्राणि नवरत्नकम् ।
मध्ये लिङ्गं महद् द्रव्यं निःक्षिपेत्सहवैदिके ॥

1.11.s:
sampūjya liṅgaṃ sadyādyaiḥ pañcasthāne yathākramam |
agnau ca hutvā bahudhā haviṣā sakulaṃ ca mām ||
1.11.d:
सम्पूज्य लिङ्गं सद्याद्यैः पञ्चस्थाने यथाक्रमम् ।
अग्नौ च हुत्वा बहुधा हविषा सकुलं च माम् ॥

1.11.s:
abhyarcya gurumācāryamarthaiḥ kāmaiśca bāndhavam |
dadyādaiśvaryamarthibhyo jaḍamapyajaḍaṃ tathā ||
1.11.d:
अभ्यर्च्य गुरुमाचार्यमर्थैः कामैश्च बान्धवम् ।
दद्यादैश्वर्यमर्थिभ्यो जडमप्यजडं तथा ॥
1.11.m: one should give wealth to supplicants, both inanimate and animate. / Having carefully gratified all living beings, stationary and moving,

1.11.s:
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ jīvaṃ sarvaṃ santoṣya yatnataḥ |
suvarṇapūrite śvabhre navaratnaiśca pūrite ||
1.11.d:
स्थावरं जङ्गमं जीवं सर्वं सन्तोष्य यत्नतः ।
सुवर्णपूरिते श्वभ्रे नवरत्नैश्च पूरिते ॥

1.11.s:
sadyādi brahma coccārya dhyātvā devaṃ paraṃ śubham |
udīrya ca mahāmantramoṅkāraṃ nādaghoṣitam ||
1.11.d:
सद्यादि ब्रह्म चोच्चार्य ध्यात्वा देवं परं शुभम् ।
उदीर्य च महामन्त्रमोङ्कारं नादघोषितम् ॥
1.11.m: in a cavity filled with gold and filled with the nine gems, / having pronounced the Sadyojāta and other Brahman mantras and meditated upon the supreme, auspicious god,

1.11.s:
liṅgaṃ tatra pratiṣṭhāpya liṅgaṃ pīṭhena yojayet |
liṅgaṃ sapīṭhaṃ nikṣipya nityalepena bandhayet ||
1.11.d:
लिङ्गं तत्र प्रतिष्ठाप्य लिङ्गं पीठेन योजयेत् ।
लिङ्गं सपीठं निक्षिप्य नित्यलेपेन बन्धयेत् ॥

1.11.s:
evaṃ veraṃ ca saṃsthāpyaṃ tatraiva paramaṃ śubham |
pañcākṣareṇa veraṃ tu utsavārthaṃ bahistathā ||
1.11.d:
एवं वेरं च संस्थाप्यं तत्रैव परमं शुभम् ।
पञ्चाक्षरेण वेरं तु उत्सवार्थं बहिस्तथा ॥

1.11.s:
veraṃ gurubhyo gṛhṇīyātsādhubhiḥ pūjitaṃ tu vā |
evaṃ liṅge ca vere ca pūjā śivapadapradā ||
1.11.d:
वेरं गुरुभ्यो गृह्णीयात्साधुभिः पूजितं तु वा ।
एवं लिङ्गे च वेरे च पूजा शिवपदप्रदा ॥
1.11.m: The image [is installed] with the five-syllable mantra, and outside for festival purposes. / One should obtain the image from gurus, or one that has been worshipped by the virtuous.

1.11.s:
punaśca dvividhaṃ proktaṃ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ tathā |
sthāvaraṃ liṅgamityāhustarugulmādikaṃ tathā ||
1.11.d:
पुनश्च द्विविधं प्रोक्तं स्थावरं जङ्गमं तथा ।
स्थावरं लिङ्गमित्याहुस्तरुगुल्मादिकं तथा ॥

1.11.s:
jaṅgamaṃ liṅgamityāhuḥ kṛmikīṭādikaṃ tathā |
sthāvarasya ca śuśrūṣā jaṅgamasya ca tarpaṇam ||
1.11.d:
जङ्गमं लिङ्गमित्याहुः कृमिकीटादिकं तथा ।
स्थावरस्य च शुश्रूषा जङ्गमस्य च तर्पणम् ॥

1.11.s:
tattatsukhānurāgeṇa śivapūjāṃ vidurbudhāḥ |
pīṭhamambāmayaṃ sarvaṃ śivaliṅgaṃ ca cinmayam ||
1.11.d:
तत्तत्सुखानुरागेण शिवपूजां विदुर्बुधाः ।
पीठमम्बामयं सर्वं शिवलिङ्गं च चिन्मयम् ॥

1.11.s:
yathā devīmumāmaṅke dhṛtvā tiṣṭhati śaṅkaraḥ |
tathā liṅgamidaṃ pīṭhaṃ dhṛtvā tiṣṭhati santatam ||
1.11.d:
यथा देवीमुमामङ्के धृत्वा तिष्ठति शङ्करः ।
तथा लिङ्गमिदं पीठं धृत्वा तिष्ठति सन्ततम् ॥

1.11.s:
evaṃ sthāpya mahāliṅgaṃ pūjayedupacārakaiḥ |
nityapūjā yathāśakti dhvajādikaraṇaṃ tathā ||
1.11.d:
एवं स्थाप्य महालिङ्गं पूजयेदुपचारकैः ।
नित्यपूजा यथाशक्ति ध्वजादिकरणं तथा ॥

1.11.s:
iti saṃsthāpayelliṅgaṃ sākṣācchivapadapradam |
athavā caraliṅgaṃ tu ṣoḍaśairupacārakaiḥ ||
1.11.d:
इति संस्थापयेल्लिङ्गं साक्षाच्छिवपदप्रदम् ।
अथवा चरलिङ्गं तु षोडशैरुपचारकैः ॥
1.11.m:
Thus one should install a liṅga, which directly bestows the state of Śiva.
Or one should worship a movable liṅga with the sixteen articles of service

1.11.s:
pūjayecca yathānyāyaṃ kramācchivapadapradam |
āvāhanaṃ cāsanaṃ ca arghyaṃ pādyaṃ tathaiva ca ||
1.11.d:
पूजयेच्च यथान्यायं क्रमाच्छिवपदप्रदम् ।
आवाहनं चासनं च अर्घ्यं पाद्यं तथैव च ॥
1.11.m:
Alternatively, one should worship a movable liṅga with the sixteen offerings / according to rule, which progressively bestows the state of Śiva:
invocation, seat, water for guest-offering, water for the feet, / sipping water for its limbs, and bath preceded by anointing,

1.11.s:
tadaṅgācamanaṃ caiva snānamabhyaṅgapūrvakam |
vastraṃ gandhaṃ tathā puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ nivedanam ||
1.11.d:
तदङ्गाचमनं चैव स्नानमभ्यङ्गपूर्वकम् ।
वस्त्रं गन्धं तथा पुष्पं धूपं दीपं निवेदनम् ॥

1.11.s:
nīrājanaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ namaskāro visarjanam |
athavārghyādikaṃ kṛtvā naivedyāntaṃ yathāvidhi ||
1.11.d:
नीराजनं च ताम्बूलं नमस्कारो विसर्जनम् ।
अथवार्घ्यादिकं कृत्वा नैवेद्यान्तं यथाविधि ॥

1.11.s:
athābhiṣekaṃ naivedyaṃ namaskāraṃ ca tarpaṇam |
yathāśakti sadā kuryātkramācchivapadapradam ||
1.11.d:
अथाभिषेकं नैवेद्यं नमस्कारं च तर्पणम् ।
यथाशक्ति सदा कुर्यात्क्रमाच्छिवपदप्रदम् ॥
1.11.m:
Or, having offered the guest-offering and the rest, ending with the food-offering according to rule, / or the bath, food-offering, prostration, and water libation,
one should always perform [them] according to one's ability; it progressively bestows the state of Śiva. / Alternatively, on a human liṅga, or one made by sages, gods, or self-manifest,

1.11.s:
athavā mānuṣe liṅge'pyārṣe daive svayambhuvi |
sthāpite'pūrvake liṅge sopacāraṃ yathā tathā ||
1.11.d:
अथवा मानुषे लिङ्गेऽप्यार्षे दैवे स्वयम्भुवि ।
स्थापितेऽपूर्वके लिङ्गे सोपचारं यथा तथा ॥

1.11.s:
pūjopakaraṇe datte yatkiñcitphalamaśnute |
pradakṣiṇānamaskāraiḥ kramācchivapadapradam ||
1.11.d:
पूजोपकरणे दत्ते यत्किञ्चित्फलमश्नुते ।
प्रदक्षिणानमस्कारैः क्रमाच्छिवपदप्रदम् ॥
1.11.m: Through circumambulations and prostrations it progressively bestows the state of Śiva; / or merely beholding the liṅga regularly bestows [the state of] Śiva.

1.11.s:
liṅgadarśanamātraṃ vā niyamena śivapradam |
mṛtpiṣṭagośakṛtpuṣpaiḥ karavīreṇa vā phalaiḥ ||
1.11.d:
लिङ्गदर्शनमात्रं वा नियमेन शिवप्रदम् ।
मृत्पिष्टगोशकृत्पुष्पैः करवीरेण वा फलैः ॥
1.11.m: With clay, flour, cow dung, flowers, or oleander, or with fruits, / with jaggery, fresh butter, ashes, or cooked food, according to one's liking,

1.11.s:
guḍena navanītena bhasmanānnairyathāruci |
liṅgaṃ yatnena kṛtvānte yajettadanusārataḥ ||
1.11.d:
गुडेन नवनीतेन भस्मनान्नैर्यथारुचि ।
लिङ्गं यत्नेन कृत्वान्ते यजेत्तदनुसारतः ॥

1.11.s:
aṅguṣṭhādāvapi tathā pūjāmicchanti kecana |
liṅgakarmaṇi sarvatra niṣedho'sti na karhicit ||
1.11.d:
अङ्गुष्ठादावपि तथा पूजामिच्छन्ति केचन ।
लिङ्गकर्मणि सर्वत्र निषेधोऽस्ति न कर्हिचित् ॥

1.11.s:
sarvatra phaladātā hi prayāsānuguṇaṃ śivaḥ |
athavā liṅgadānaṃ vā liṅgamaulyamathāpi vā ||
1.11.d:
सर्वत्र फलदाता हि प्रयासानुगुणं शिवः ।
अथवा लिङ्गदानं वा लिङ्गमौल्यमथापि वा ॥

1.11.s:
śraddhayā śivabhaktāya dattaṃ śivapadapradam |
athavā praṇavaṃ nityaṃ japeddaśasahasrakam ||
1.11.d:
श्रद्धया शिवभक्ताय दत्तं शिवपदप्रदम् ।
अथवा प्रणवं नित्यं जपेद्दशसहस्रकम् ॥
1.11.m: Or the gift of a liṅga, or the cost of a liṅga, / given with faith to a devotee of Śiva, bestows the state of Śiva.

1.11.s:
sandhyayośca sahasraṃ vā jñeyaṃ śivapadapradam |
japakāle makārāntaṃ manaḥśuddhikaraṃ bhavet ||
1.11.d:
सन्ध्ययोश्च सहस्रं वा ज्ञेयं शिवपदप्रदम् ।
जपकाले मकारान्तं मनःशुद्धिकरं भवेत् ॥

1.11.s:
samādhau mānasaṃ proktamupāṃśusārvakālikam |
samānapraṇavaṃ cemaṃ bindunādayutaṃ viduḥ ||
1.11.d:
समाधौ मानसं प्रोक्तमुपांशुसार्वकालिकम् ।
समानप्रणवं चेमं बिन्दुनादयुतं विदुः ॥
1.11.m: At the time of recitation, one should repeat [the sound] ending in the letter 'm', which purifies the mind. / In absorption it is said to be mental; at all other times it is in a whisper.

1.11.s:
atha pañcākṣaraṃ nityaṃ japedayutamādarāt |
sandhyayośca sahasraṃ vā jñeyaṃ śivapadapradam ||
1.11.d:
अथ पञ्चाक्षरं नित्यं जपेदयुतमादरात् ।
सन्ध्ययोश्च सहस्रं वा ज्ञेयं शिवपदप्रदम् ॥
1.11.m: Alternatively, one should daily recite the syllable Oṃ ten thousand times, / or one thousand times at the two daily twilights; it should be known to bestow the state of Śiva.

1.11.s:
praṇavenādisaṃyuktaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ viśiṣyate |
dīkṣāyuktaṃ gurorgrāhyaṃ mantraṃ hyatha phalāptaye ||
1.11.d:
प्रणवेनादिसंयुक्तं ब्राह्मणानां विशिष्यते ।
दीक्षायुक्तं गुरोर्ग्राह्यं मन्त्रं ह्यथ फलाप्तये ॥
1.11.m: or one thousand times at the two daily twilights; it should be known to bestow the state of Śiva. / Prefixed with the syllable Oṃ at the beginning, it is especially prescribed for Brahmins.

1.11.s:
kumbhasnānaṃ mantradīkṣāṃ mātṛkānyāsameva ca |
brāhmaṇaḥ satyapūtātmā gururjñānī viśiṣyate ||
1.11.d:
कुम्भस्नानं मन्त्रदीक्षां मातृकान्यासमेव च ।
ब्राह्मणः सत्यपूतात्मा गुरुर्ज्ञानी विशिष्यते ॥
1.11.m: A Brahmin whose self is purified by truth, a wise guru, is distinguished. / For twice-born it has 'namaḥ' at the beginning, and for others it ends with 'namaḥ'.

1.11.s:
dvijānāṃ ca namaḥ pūrvamanyeṣāṃ ca namontakam |
strīṇāṃ ca kecidicchanti namo'ntaṃ ca yathāvidhi ||
1.11.d:
द्विजानां च नमः पूर्वमन्येषां च नमोन्तकम् ।
स्त्रीणां च केचिदिच्छन्ति नमोऽन्तं च यथाविधि ॥

1.11.s:
viprastrīṇāṃ namaḥ pūrvamidamicchanti kecana |
pañcakoṭijapaṃ kṛtvā sadāśivasamo bhavet ||
1.11.d:
विप्रस्त्रीणां नमः पूर्वमिदमिच्छन्ति केचन ।
पञ्चकोटिजपं कृत्वा सदाशिवसमो भवेत् ॥

1.11.s:
ekadvitricatuḥ koṭyā brahmādīnāṃ padaṃ vrajet |
japedakṣaralakṣaṃ vā akṣarāṇāṃ pṛthakpṛthak ||
1.11.d:
एकद्वित्रिचतुः कोट्या ब्रह्मादीनां पदं व्रजेत् ।
जपेदक्षरलक्षं वा अक्षराणां पृथक्पृथक् ॥
1.11.m:
Having performed fifty million recitations, one becomes equal to Śiva forever. / By ten, twenty, thirty, or forty million, one goes to the abode of Brahmā and the others.
One should recite one hundred thousand per syllable, or for each syllable separately; / or [simply] one hundred thousand syllables should be known to bestow the state of Śiva.

1.11.s:
athavākṣaralakṣaṃ vā jñeyaṃ śivapadapradam |
sahasraṃ tu sahasrāṇāṃ sahasreṇa dinena hi ||
1.11.d:
अथवाक्षरलक्षं वा ज्ञेयं शिवपदप्रदम् ।
सहस्रं तु सहस्राणां सहस्रेण दिनेन हि ॥

1.11.s:
japenmantrādiṣṭasiddhirnityaṃ brāhmaṇabhojanāt |
aṣṭottarasahasraṃ vai gāyatrīṃ prātareva hi ||
1.11.d:
जपेन्मन्त्रादिष्टसिद्धिर्नित्यं ब्राह्मणभोजनात् ।
अष्टोत्तरसहस्रं वै गायत्रीं प्रातरेव हि ॥

1.11.s:
brāhmaṇastu japennityaṃ kramācchivapadapradām |
vedamantrāṃśca sūktāni japenniyamamāsthitaḥ ||
1.11.d:
ब्राह्मणस्तु जपेन्नित्यं क्रमाच्छिवपदप्रदाम् ।
वेदमन्त्रांश्च सूक्तानि जपेन्नियममास्थितः ॥

1.11.s:
ekaṃ daśārṇamantraṃ ca śatonaṃ ca tadūrdhvakam |
ayutaṃ ca sahasraṃ ca śatamekaṃ vinā bhavet ||
1.11.d:
एकं दशार्णमन्त्रं च शतोनं च तदूर्ध्वकम् ।
अयुतं च सहस्रं च शतमेकं विना भवेत् ॥

1.11.s:
vedapārāyaṇaṃ caiva jñeyaṃ śivapadapradam |
anyānbahutarānmantrāñjapedakṣaralakṣataḥ ||
1.11.d:
वेदपारायणं चैव ज्ञेयं शिवपदप्रदम् ।
अन्यान्बहुतरान्मन्त्राञ्जपेदक्षरलक्षतः ॥

1.11.s:
ekākṣarāṃstathā mantrāñjapedakṣarakoṭitaḥ |
tataḥ paraṃ japeccaiva sahasraṃ bhaktipūrvakam ||
1.11.d:
एकाक्षरांस्तथा मन्त्राञ्जपेदक्षरकोटितः ।
ततः परं जपेच्चैव सहस्रं भक्तिपूर्वकम् ॥
1.11.m: Beyond that, one should recite one thousand with devotion. / One should act thus according to one's ability; progressively one obtains the state of Śiva.

1.11.s:
evaṃ kuryādyathāśakti kramācchivapadaṃ labhet |
nityaṃ rucikaraṃ tvekaṃ mantramāmaraṇāntikam ||
1.11.d:
एवं कुर्याद्यथाशक्ति क्रमाच्छिवपदं लभेत् ।
नित्यं रुचिकरं त्वेकं मन्त्रमामरणान्तिकम् ॥

1.11.s:
sahasramomiti japetsarvābhīṣṭaṃ śivājñayā |
puṣpārāmādikaṃ vāpi tathā sammārjanādikam ||
1.11.d:
सहस्रमोमिति जपेत्सर्वाभीष्टं शिवाज्ञया ।
पुष्पारामादिकं वापि तथा सम्मार्जनादिकम् ॥

1.11.s:
śivāya śivakāryārthe kṛtvā śivapadaṃ labhet |
śivakṣetre tathā vāsaṃ nityaṃ kuryācca bhaktitaḥ ||
1.11.d:
शिवाय शिवकार्यार्थे कृत्वा शिवपदं लभेत् ।
शिवक्षेत्रे तथा वासं नित्यं कुर्याच्च भक्तितः ॥
1.11.m: Likewise, one should always dwell in a sacred field of Śiva with devotion; / it bestows enjoyment and liberation upon all, whether inanimate or animate.

1.11.s:
jaḍānāmajaḍānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ bhuktimuktidam |
tasmādvāsaṃ śivakṣetre kuryādāmaraṇaṃ budhaḥ ||
1.11.d:
जडानामजडानां च सर्वेषां भुक्तिमुक्तिदम् ।
तस्माद्वासं शिवक्षेत्रे कुर्यादामरणं बुधः ॥
1.11.m: Therefore, the wise person should reside in a sacred field of Śiva until death. / A hundred cubits from the liṅga is known to be the holy area around a human-made one.

1.11.s:
liṅgāddhastaśataṃ puṇyaṃ kṣetre mānuṣake viduḥ |
sahasrāratnimātraṃ tu puṇyaṃ kṣetre tathārṣake ||
1.11.d:
लिङ्गाद्धस्तशतं पुण्यं क्षेत्रे मानुषके विदुः ।
सहस्रारत्निमात्रं तु पुण्यं क्षेत्रे तथार्षके ॥

1.11.s:
daivaliṅge tathā jñeyaṃ sahasrāratnimānataḥ |
dhanuḥpramāṇasāhasraṃ puṇyaṃ kṣetre svayambhuvi ||
1.11.d:
दैवलिङ्गे तथा ज्ञेयं सहस्रारत्निमानतः ।
धनुःप्रमाणसाहस्रं पुण्यं क्षेत्रे स्वयम्भुवि ॥

1.11.s:
puṇyakṣetre sthitā vāpī kūpādyaṃ puṣkarāṇi ca |
śivagaṅgeti vijñeyaṃ śivasya vacanaṃ yathā ||
1.11.d:
पुण्यक्षेत्रे स्थिता वापी कूपाद्यं पुष्कराणि च ।
शिवगङ्गेति विज्ञेयं शिवस्य वचनं यथा ॥

1.11.s:
tatra snātvā tathā dattvā japitvā hi śivaṃ vrajet |
śivakṣetraṃ samāśritya vasedāmaraṇaṃ tathā ||
1.11.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा तथा दत्त्वा जपित्वा हि शिवं व्रजेत् ।
शिवक्षेत्रं समाश्रित्य वसेदामरणं तथा ॥
1.11.m: should be known as Śiva's Gaṅgā, according to Śiva's word. / Bathing there, and likewise giving and reciting [mantras], one indeed goes to Śiva.

1.11.s:
dvāhaṃ daśāhaṃ māsyaṃ vā sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ tu vā |
ābdikaṃ vā śivakṣetre kṣetre piṇḍamathāpi vā ||
1.11.d:
द्वाहं दशाहं मास्यं वा सपिण्डीकरणं तु वा ।
आब्दिकं वा शिवक्षेत्रे क्षेत्रे पिण्डमथापि वा ॥

1.11.s:
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sadyaḥ śivapadaṃ labhet |
athavā saptarātraṃ vā vasedvā pañcarātrakam ||
1.11.d:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः सद्यः शिवपदं लभेत् ।
अथवा सप्तरात्रं वा वसेद्वा पञ्चरात्रकम् ॥
1.11.m: or the annual rite, or an ancestral ball in the field: / freed from all sins, one immediately attains the state of Śiva.

1.11.s:
trirātramekarātraṃ vā kramācchivapadaṃ labhet |
svavarṇānuguṇaṃ loke svācārātprāpnute naraḥ ||
1.11.d:
त्रिरात्रमेकरात्रं वा क्रमाच्छिवपदं लभेत् ।
स्ववर्णानुगुणं लोके स्वाचारात्प्राप्नुते नरः ॥
1.11.m:
Or one should dwell for seven nights, or dwell for five nights, / three nights, or one night; progressively one obtains the state of Śiva.
In this world a person attains [fruit] from their own conduct according to their social class; / by elevating one's class and by devotion, a person attains an abundance of that fruit.

1.11.s:
varṇoddhāreṇa bhaktyā ca tatphalātiśayaṃ naraḥ |
sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ kāmanayā sadyaḥ phalamavāpnuyāt ||
1.11.d:
वर्णोद्धारेण भक्त्या च तत्फलातिशयं नरः ।
सर्वं कृतं कामनया सद्यः फलमवाप्नुयात् ॥
1.11.m: Everything done with desire obtains immediate fruit; / everything done without desire directly bestows the state of Śiva.

1.11.s:
sarvaṃ kṛtamakāmena sākṣācchivapadapradam |
prātarmadhyāhnasāyāhnamahastriṣvekataḥ kramāt ||
1.11.d:
सर्वं कृतमकामेन साक्षाच्छिवपदप्रदम् ।
प्रातर्मध्याह्नसायाह्नमहस्त्रिष्वेकतः क्रमात् ॥
1.11.m: Morning, midday, and evening—among the three parts of the day in succession: / morning should be known as fulfilling duty, midday as fulfilling desires,

1.11.s:
prātarvidhikaraṃ jñeyaṃ madhyāhnaṃ kāmikaṃ tathā |
sāyāhnaṃ śāntikaṃ jñeyaṃ rātrāvapi tathaiva hi ||
1.11.d:
प्रातर्विधिकरं ज्ञेयं मध्याह्नं कामिकं तथा ।
सायाह्नं शान्तिकं ज्ञेयं रात्रावपि तथैव हि ॥

1.11.s:
kālo niśītho vai prokto madhyayāmadvayaṃ niśi |
śivapūjā viśeṣeṇa tatkāle'bhīṣṭasiddhidā ||
1.11.d:
कालो निशीथो वै प्रोक्तो मध्ययामद्वयं निशि ।
शिवपूजा विशेषेण तत्कालेऽभीष्टसिद्धिदा ॥
1.11.m: and evening should be known as bringing peace; likewise at night also. / The period called midnight is indeed the two middle watches of the night.

1.11.s:
evaṃ jñātvā naraḥ kurvanyathoktaphalabhāgbhavet |
kalau yuge viśeṣeṇa phalasiddhistu karmaṇā ||
1.11.d:
एवं ज्ञात्वा नरः कुर्वन्यथोक्तफलभाग्भवेत् ।
कलौ युगे विशेषेण फलसिद्धिस्तु कर्मणा ॥
1.11.m: Worship of Śiva at that time particularly grants the attainment of desired ends. / Knowing this, a person who acts accordingly becomes a recipient of the stated fruits.

1.11.s:
uktena kenacidvāpi hyadhikāravibhedataḥ |
sadvṛttiḥ pāpabhīruścettattatphalamavāpnuyāt ||
1.11.d:
उक्तेन केनचिद्वापि ह्यधिकारविभेदतः ।
सद्वृत्तिः पापभीरुश्चेत्तत्तत्फलमवाप्नुयात् ॥

1.11.s:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
atha kṣetrāṇi puṇyāni samāsātkathayasva naḥ |
sarvāḥ striyaśca puruṣā yānyāśritya padaṃ labhet ||
1.11.d:
ऋषय ऊचुः ।
अथ क्षेत्राणि पुण्यानि समासात्कथयस्व नः ।
सर्वाः स्त्रियश्च पुरुषा यान्याश्रित्य पदं लभेत् ॥
1.11.m:
If one is of good conduct and fearful of sin, one attains those various fruits. / The sages said: / Now tell us briefly of the holy fields,
taking refuge in which all women and men may attain the state [of Śiva], / O Sūta, foremost of excellent yogins, and also the traditions of Śiva's sacred fields.

1.11.s:
sūta yogivaraśreṣṭha śivakṣetrāgamāṃstathā |
sūta uvāca |
śṛṇuta śraddhayā sarvakṣetrāṇi ca tadāgamān ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
vidyeśvarasaṃhitā
1.11.d:
सूत योगिवरश्रेष्ठ शिवक्षेत्रागमांस्तथा ।
सूत उवाच ।
शृणुत श्रद्धया सर्वक्षेत्राणि च तदागमान् ॥
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥
विद्येश्वरसंहिता
1.11.m:
Sūta said: / Listen with faith to all the sacred fields and their traditions.

Homage to the illustrious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

1.12.s:
sūta uvāca |
śṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ prājñāḥ śivakṣetraṃ vimuktidam |
tadāgamāṃstato vakṣye lokarakṣārthameva hi ||
1.12.d:
सूत उवाच ।
शृणुध्वमृषयः प्राज्ञाः शिवक्षेत्रं विमुक्तिदम् ।
तदागमांस्ततो वक्ष्ये लोकरक्षार्थमेव हि ॥
1.12.m: Chapter 12 / Sūta said: / Listen, O wise sages, to the sacred field of Śiva that bestows complete liberation.

1.12.s:
pañcāśatkoṭivistīrṇā saśailavanakānanā |
śivājñayā hi pṛthivī lokaṃ dhṛtvā ca tiṣṭhati ||
1.12.d:
पञ्चाशत्कोटिविस्तीर्णा सशैलवनकानना ।
शिवाज्ञया हि पृथिवी लोकं धृत्वा च तिष्ठति ॥

1.12.s:
tatra tatra śivakṣetraṃ tatra tatra nivāsinām |
mokṣārthaṃ kṛpayā devaḥ kṣetraṃ kalpitavānprabhuḥ ||
1.12.d:
तत्र तत्र शिवक्षेत्रं तत्र तत्र निवासिनाम् ।
मोक्षार्थं कृपया देवः क्षेत्रं कल्पितवान्प्रभुः ॥
1.12.m:
the earth indeed stands upholding the world by the command of Śiva. / Here and there is a sacred field of Śiva for those who dwell in those various places.
For the sake of liberation, the Lord God compassionately fashioned the field, / through the adoption by the sages and through the adoption by the gods.

1.12.s:
parigrahād ṝṣīṇāṃ ca devānāṃ ca parigrahāt |
svayambhūtānyathānyāni lokarakṣārthameva hi ||
1.12.d:
परिग्रहाद् ॠषीणां च देवानां च परिग्रहात् ।
स्वयम्भूतान्यथान्यानि लोकरक्षार्थमेव हि ॥
1.12.m: Others are self-manifest, solely for the protection of the worlds. / In a sacred ford or field, one must constantly perform bathing, giving, recitation of mantras, and the like.

1.12.s:
tīrthe kṣetre sadā kāryaṃ snānadānajapādikam |
anyathā rogadāridryamūkatvādyāpnuyānnaraḥ ||
1.12.d:
तीर्थे क्षेत्रे सदा कार्यं स्नानदानजपादिकम् ।
अन्यथा रोगदारिद्र्यमूकत्वाद्याप्नुयान्नरः ॥
1.12.m: Otherwise, a person incurs disease, poverty, dumbness, and other afflictions. / Now, if a man meets death in this continent of Bhārata,

1.12.s:
athāsminbhārate varṣe prāpnoti maraṇaṃ naraḥ |
svayambhūsthānavāsena punarmānuṣyamāpnuyāt ||
1.12.d:
अथास्मिन्भारते वर्षे प्राप्नोति मरणं नरः ।
स्वयम्भूस्थानवासेन पुनर्मानुष्यमाप्नुयात् ॥
1.12.m: he attains human birth again through dwelling in a self-manifest place. / The commission of a sin in a sacred field becomes deeply rooted, O earthly gods.

1.12.s:
kṣetre pāpasya karaṇaṃ dṛḍhaṃ bhavati bhūsurāḥ |
puṇyakṣetre nivāse hi pāpamaṇvapi nācaret ||
1.12.d:
क्षेत्रे पापस्य करणं दृढं भवति भूसुराः ।
पुण्यक्षेत्रे निवासे हि पापमण्वपि नाचरेत् ॥

1.12.s:
yena kenāpyupāyena puṇyakṣetre vasennaraḥ |
sindhoḥ śatanadītīre santi kṣetrāṇyanekaśaḥ ||
1.12.d:
येन केनाप्युपायेन पुण्यक्षेत्रे वसेन्नरः ।
सिन्धोः शतनदीतीरे सन्ति क्षेत्राण्यनेकशः ॥

1.12.s:
sarasvatī nadī puṇyā proktā ṣaṣṭimukhā tathā |
tattattīre vasetprājñaḥ kramād brahmapadaṃ labhet ||
1.12.d:
सरस्वती नदी पुण्या प्रोक्ता षष्टिमुखा तथा ।
तत्तत्तीरे वसेत्प्राज्ञः क्रमाद् ब्रह्मपदं लभेत् ॥
1.12.m: A wise man who dwells on their banks gradually attains the abode of Brahmā. / The holy Gaṅgā, born from the Himālaya mountain, is a river of a hundred mouths.

1.12.s:
himavadgirijā gaṅgā puṇyā śatamukhā nadī |
tattīre caiva kāśyādipuṇyakṣetrāṇyanekaśaḥ ||
1.12.d:
हिमवद्गिरिजा गङ्गा पुण्या शतमुखा नदी ।
तत्तीरे चैव काश्यादिपुण्यक्षेत्राण्यनेकशः ॥
1.12.m: And on its banks are numerous holy fields such as Kāśī. / The bank there is most praiseworthy indeed when Jupiter is in Capricorn.

1.12.s:
tatra tīraṃ praśastaṃ hi mṛge mṛgabṛhaspatau |
śoṇabhadro daśamukhaḥ puṇyo'bhīṣṭaphalapradaḥ ||
1.12.d:
तत्र तीरं प्रशस्तं हि मृगे मृगबृहस्पतौ ।
शोणभद्रो दशमुखः पुण्योऽभीष्टफलप्रदः ॥
1.12.m: The holy Śoṇabhadra has ten mouths, granting desired fruits; / by bathing and fasting there, one attains the abode of Vināyaka.

1.12.s:
tatra snānopavāsena padaṃ vaināyakaṃ labhet |
caturvīṃśamukhā puṇyā narmadā ca mahānadī ||
1.12.d:
तत्र स्नानोपवासेन पदं वैनायकं लभेत् ।
चतुर्वींशमुखा पुण्या नर्मदा च महानदी ॥

1.12.s:
tasyāṃ snānena vāsena padaṃ vaiṣṇavamāpnuyāt |
tamasā dvādaśamukhā revā daśamukhā nadī ||
1.12.d:
तस्यां स्नानेन वासेन पदं वैष्णवमाप्नुयात् ।
तमसा द्वादशमुखा रेवा दशमुखा नदी ॥
1.12.m: The holy Narmadā, a great river, has twenty-four mouths; / by bathing and dwelling in it, one attains the abode of Viṣṇu.

1.12.s:
godāvarī mahāpuṇyā brahmagovadhanāśinī |
ekaviṃśamukhā proktā rudralokapradāyinī ||
1.12.d:
गोदावरी महापुण्या ब्रह्मगोवधनाशिनी ।
एकविंशमुखा प्रोक्ता रुद्रलोकप्रदायिनी ॥

1.12.s:
kṛṣṇa veṇī puṇyanadī sarvapāpakṣayāvahā |
sāṣṭādaśamukhā proktā viṣṇulokapradāyinī ||
1.12.d:
कृष्ण वेणी पुण्यनदी सर्वपापक्षयावहा ।
साष्टादशमुखा प्रोक्ता विष्णुलोकप्रदायिनी ॥

1.12.s:
tuṅgabhadrā daśamukhā brahmalokapradāyinī |
suvarṇamukharī puṇyā proktā navamukhā tathā ||
1.12.d:
तुङ्गभद्रा दशमुखा ब्रह्मलोकप्रदायिनी ।
सुवर्णमुखरी पुण्या प्रोक्ता नवमुखा तथा ॥

1.12.s:
tatraiva suprajāyante brahmalokacyutāstathā |
sarasvatī ca pampā ca kanyā śvetanadī śubhā ||
1.12.d:
तत्रैव सुप्रजायन्ते ब्रह्मलोकच्युतास्तथा ।
सरस्वती च पम्पा च कन्या श्वेतनदी शुभा ॥

1.12.s:
etāsāṃ tīravāsena indralokamavāpnuyāt |
sahyādrijā mahāpuṇyā kāverīti mahānadī ||
1.12.d:
एतासां तीरवासेन इन्द्रलोकमवाप्नुयात् ।
सह्याद्रिजा महापुण्या कावेरीति महानदी ॥

1.12.s:
saptaviṃśamukhā proktā sarvābhīṣṭapradāyinī |
tattīrāḥ svargadāścaiva brahmaviṣṇupadapradāḥ ||
1.12.d:
सप्तविंशमुखा प्रोक्ता सर्वाभीष्टप्रदायिनी ।
तत्तीराः स्वर्गदाश्चैव ब्रह्मविष्णुपदप्रदाः ॥
1.12.m: Its banks grant heaven and bestow the abodes of Brahmā and Viṣṇu; / those sacred to Śiva grant the world of Śiva, likewise granting desired fruits.

1.12.s:
śivalokapradāḥ śaivāstathābhīṣṭaphalapradāḥ |
naimiṣe badare snāyānmeṣage ca gurau ravau ||
1.12.d:
शिवलोकप्रदाः शैवास्तथाभीष्टफलप्रदाः ।
नैमिषे बदरे स्नायान्मेषगे च गुरौ रवौ ॥

1.12.s:
brahmalokapradaṃ vidyāttataḥ pūjādikaṃ tathā |
sindhunadyāṃ tathā snānaṃ siṃhe karkaṭage ravau ||
1.12.d:
ब्रह्मलोकप्रदं विद्यात्ततः पूजादिकं तथा ।
सिन्धुनद्यां तथा स्नानं सिंहे कर्कटगे रवौ ॥
1.12.m: One should bathe in Naimiṣa and Badarī when Jupiter and the Sun are in Aries; / one should know that it bestows the world of Brahmā, and likewise the worship performed thereafter.

1.12.s:
kedārodakapānaṃ ca snānaṃ ca jñānadaṃ viduḥ |
godāvaryāṃ siṃhamāse snāyātsiṃhabṛhaspatau ||
1.12.d:
केदारोदकपानं च स्नानं च ज्ञानदं विदुः ।
गोदावर्यां सिंहमासे स्नायात्सिंहबृहस्पतौ ॥
1.12.m: One should bathe in the Godāvarī during the month of Leo when Jupiter is in Leo; / it bestows the world of Śiva, as was proclaimed by Śiva in ancient times.

1.12.s:
śivalokapradamiti śivenoktaṃ tathā purā |
yamunāśoṇayoḥ snāyād gurau kanyāgate ravau ||
1.12.d:
शिवलोकप्रदमिति शिवेनोक्तं तथा पुरा ।
यमुनाशोणयोः स्नायाद् गुरौ कन्यागते रवौ ॥

1.12.s:
dharmaloke dantiloke mahābhogapradaṃ viduḥ |
kāveryāṃ ca tathā snāyāttulāge tu ravau gurau ||
1.12.d:
धर्मलोके दन्तिलोके महाभोगप्रदं विदुः ।
कावेर्यां च तथा स्नायात्तुलागे तु रवौ गुरौ ॥

1.12.s:
viṣṇorvacanamāhātmyātsarvābhīṣṭapradaṃ viduḥ |
vṛścike māsi samprāpte tathārke guruvṛścike ||
1.12.d:
विष्णोर्वचनमाहात्म्यात्सर्वाभीष्टप्रदं विदुः ।
वृश्चिके मासि सम्प्राप्ते तथार्के गुरुवृश्चिके ॥
1.12.m: And one should likewise bathe in the Kāverī when the Sun and Jupiter enter Libra; / by the power of Viṣṇu’s word, they know it grants every desired wish.

1.12.s:
narmadāyāṃ nadīsnānādviṣṇulokamavāpnuyāt |
suvarṇamukharīsnānāṃ cāpage ca gurau ravau ||
1.12.d:
नर्मदायां नदीस्नानाद्विष्णुलोकमवाप्नुयात् ।
सुवर्णमुखरीस्नानां चापगे च गुरौ रवौ ॥

1.12.s:
śivalokapradamiti brāhmaṇo vacanaṃ yathā |
mṛgamāsi tathā snāyājjāhnavyāṃ mṛgage gurau ||
1.12.d:
शिवलोकप्रदमिति ब्राह्मणो वचनं यथा ।
मृगमासि तथा स्नायाज्जाह्नव्यां मृगगे गुरौ ॥

1.12.s:
śivalokapradamiti brahmaṇo vacanaṃ yathā |
brahmaviṣṇvoḥ pade bhuktvā tadante jñānamāpnuyāt ||
1.12.d:
शिवलोकप्रदमिति ब्रह्मणो वचनं यथा ।
ब्रह्मविष्ण्वोः पदे भुक्त्वा तदन्ते ज्ञानमाप्नुयात् ॥

1.12.s:
gaṅgāyāṃ māghamāse tu tathā kumbhagate ravau |
śrāddhaṃ vā piṇḍadānaṃ vā tilodakamathāpi vā ||
1.12.d:
गङ्गायां माघमासे तु तथा कुम्भगते रवौ ।
श्राद्धं वा पिण्डदानं वा तिलोदकमथापि वा ॥

1.12.s:
vaṃśadvayapitṝṇāṃ ca kulakoṭyuddharaṃ viduḥ |
kṛṣṇaveṇyāṃ praśaṃsanti mīnage ca gurau ravau ||
1.12.d:
वंशद्वयपितॄणां च कुलकोट्युद्धरं विदुः ।
कृष्णवेण्यां प्रशंसन्ति मीनगे च गुरौ रवौ ॥

1.12.s:
tattattīrthe ca tanmāsi snānamindrapadapradam |
gaṅgāṃ vā sahyajāṃ vāpi samāśritya vased budhaḥ ||
1.12.d:
तत्तत्तीर्थे च तन्मासि स्नानमिन्द्रपदप्रदम् ।
गङ्गां वा सह्यजां वापि समाश्रित्य वसेद् बुधः ॥

1.12.s:
tatkālakṛtapāpasya kṣayo bhavati niścitam |
rudralokapradānyeva santi kṣetrāṇyanekaśaḥ ||
1.12.d:
तत्कालकृतपापस्य क्षयो भवति निश्चितम् ।
रुद्रलोकप्रदान्येव सन्ति क्षेत्राण्यनेकशः ॥

1.12.s:
tāmraparṇī vegavatī brahmalokaphalaprade |
tayostīre hi santyeva kṣetrāṇi svargadāni ca ||
1.12.d:
ताम्रपर्णी वेगवती ब्रह्मलोकफलप्रदे ।
तयोस्तीरे हि सन्त्येव क्षेत्राणि स्वर्गदानि च ॥

1.12.s:
santi kṣetrāṇi tanmadhye puṇyadāni ca bhūriśaḥ |
tatra tatra vasanprājñastādṛśaṃ ca phalaṃ labhet ||
1.12.d:
सन्ति क्षेत्राणि तन्मध्ये पुण्यदानि च भूरिशः ।
तत्र तत्र वसन्प्राज्ञस्तादृशं च फलं लभेत् ॥
1.12.m: Dwelling in those various places, a wise man attains corresponding fruit / by good conduct, righteous livelihood, and constant right disposition.

1.12.s:
sadācāreṇa sadvṛttyā sadā bhāvanayāpi ca |
vaseddayāluḥ prājño vai nānyathā tatphalaṃ labhet ||
1.12.d:
सदाचारेण सद्वृत्त्या सदा भावनयापि च ।
वसेद्दयालुः प्राज्ञो वै नान्यथा तत्फलं लभेत् ॥
1.12.m: A wise, compassionate person should dwell there; otherwise he will not obtain that fruit. / Merit performed in a holy field increases manifold.

1.12.s:
puṇyakṣetre kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ bahudhā ṛddhimṛcchati |
puṇyakṣetre kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ mahadaṇvāpi jāyate ||
1.12.d:
पुण्यक्षेत्रे कृतं पुण्यं बहुधा ऋद्धिमृच्छति ।
पुण्यक्षेत्रे कृतं पापं महदण्वापि जायते ॥

1.12.s:
tatkālaṃ jīvanārthaścetpuṇyena kṣayameṣyati |
puṇyamaiśvaryadaṃ prāhuḥ kāyikaṃ vācikaṃ tathā ||
1.12.d:
तत्कालं जीवनार्थश्चेत्पुण्येन क्षयमेष्यति ।
पुण्यमैश्वर्यदं प्राहुः कायिकं वाचिकं तथा ॥
1.12.m:
A sin committed in a holy field, even minute, becomes enormous. / If it was committed merely to sustain life during that time, it will be destroyed by merit.
They say merit grants sovereignty, whether physical or verbal; / and likewise it destroys sin of the mind and the like, O twice-born ones.

1.12.s:
mānasaṃ ca tathā pāpaṃ tādṛśaṃ nāśayed dvijāḥ |
mānasaṃ vajralepaṃ tu kalpakalpānugaṃ tathā ||
1.12.d:
मानसं च तथा पापं तादृशं नाशयेद् द्विजाः ।
मानसं वज्रलेपं तु कल्पकल्पानुगं तथा ॥

1.12.s:
dhyānādeva hi tannaśyennānyathā nāśamṛcchati |
vācikaṃ japajālena kāyikaṃ kāyaśoṣaṇāt ||
1.12.d:
ध्यानादेव हि तन्नश्येन्नान्यथा नाशमृच्छति ।
वाचिकं जपजालेन कायिकं कायशोषणात् ॥
1.12.m: A mental [sin], however, is adamantine cement, persisting through aeon after aeon; / it is destroyed solely through meditation, and meets destruction in no other way.

1.12.s:
dānāddhanakṛtaṃ naśyennānyathā kalpakoṭibhiḥ |
kvacitpāpena puṇyaṃ ca vṛddhipūrveṇa naśyati ||
1.12.d:
दानाद्धनकृतं नश्येन्नान्यथा कल्पकोटिभिः ।
क्वचित्पापेन पुण्यं च वृद्धिपूर्वेण नश्यति ॥
1.12.m:
A verbal [sin is destroyed] by a web of mantra repetition; a bodily [sin] by emaciating the body; / a [sin] committed regarding wealth is destroyed by giving, not otherwise even through tens of millions of aeons.
Sometimes merit is destroyed by sin along with its increase. / Of merit and sin, there is the seed portion, the increased portion, and the experienced portion.

1.12.s:
bījāṃśaścaiva vṛddhyaṃśo bhogāṃśaḥ puṇyapāpayoḥ |
jñānanāśyo hi bījāṃśo vṛddhiruktaprakārataḥ ||
1.12.d:
बीजांशश्चैव वृद्ध्यंशो भोगांशः पुण्यपापयोः ।
ज्ञाननाश्यो हि बीजांशो वृद्धिरुक्तप्रकारतः ॥
1.12.m: The seed portion is destroyed by knowledge, and the increase in the manner described; / the portion to be experienced is destroyed only by experiencing it, and not otherwise even by tens of millions of merits.

1.12.s:
bhogāṃśo bhoganāśyastu nānyathā puṇyakoṭibhiḥ |
bījaprarohe naṣṭe tu śeṣo bhogāya kalpate ||
1.12.d:
भोगांशो भोगनाश्यस्तु नान्यथा पुण्यकोटिभिः ।
बीजप्ररोहे नष्टे तु शेषो भोगाय कल्पते ॥

1.12.s:
devānāṃ pūjayā caiva brahmaṇānāṃ ca dānataḥ |
tapodhikyācca kālena bhogaḥ sahyo bhavennṛṇām |
tasmātpāpamakṛtvaiva vastavyaṃ sukhamicchatā ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
vidyeśvarasaṃhitā
1.12.d:
देवानां पूजया चैव ब्रह्मणानां च दानतः ।
तपोधिक्याच्च कालेन भोगः सह्यो भवेन्नृणाम् ।
तस्मात्पापमकृत्वैव वस्तव्यं सुखमिच्छता ॥
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥
विद्येश्वरसंहिता
1.12.m:
and through excess of ascetic practice, in time the experience becomes bearable for men. / Therefore, without committing sin at all, one who desires happiness should dwell [there].

Obeisance to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

1.13.s:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
sadācāraṃ śrāvayāśu yena lokāñjayed budhaḥ |
dharmādharmamayānbrūhi svarganārakadāṃstathā ||
1.13.d:
ऋषय ऊचुः ।
सदाचारं श्रावयाशु येन लोकाञ्जयेद् बुधः ।
धर्माधर्ममयान्ब्रूहि स्वर्गनारकदांस्तथा ॥
1.13.m:
Chapter 13 / The sages said: / Declare quickly to us righteous conduct, by which a wise man may conquer the worlds;
tell us of those [acts] consisting of virtue and unrighteousness, and those granting heaven and hell. / Sūta said: / A learned man endowed with righteous conduct is truly a brāhmaṇa by name;

1.13.s:
sūta uvāca |
sadācārayuto vidvān brāhmaṇo nāma nāmataḥ |
vedācārayuto vipro hyetairekaikavāndvijaḥ ||
1.13.d:
सूत उवाच ।
सदाचारयुतो विद्वान् ब्राह्मणो नाम नामतः ।
वेदाचारयुतो विप्रो ह्येतैरेकैकवान्द्विजः ॥

1.13.s:
alpācāro'lpavedaśca kṣatriyo rājasevakaḥ |
kiñcidācāravānvaiśyaḥ kṛṣivāṇijyakṛttathā ||
1.13.d:
अल्पाचारोऽल्पवेदश्च क्षत्रियो राजसेवकः ।
किञ्चिदाचारवान्वैश्यः कृषिवाणिज्यकृत्तथा ॥

1.13.s:
śūdrabrāhmaṇa ityuktaḥ svayameva hi karṣakaḥ |
asūyāluḥ paradrohī caṇḍāladvija ucyate ||
1.13.d:
शूद्रब्राह्मण इत्युक्तः स्वयमेव हि कर्षकः ।
असूयालुः परद्रोही चण्डालद्विज उच्यते ॥
1.13.m: one with little conduct, engaging in agriculture and trade, is a vaiśya; / one who ploughs by himself is called a śūdra-brāhmaṇa;

1.13.s:
pṛthivīpālako rājā itare kṣatriyā matāḥ |
dhānyādikrayavānvaiśya itaro vaṇigucyate ||
1.13.d:
पृथिवीपालको राजा इतरे क्षत्रिया मताः ।
धान्यादिक्रयवान्वैश्य इतरो वणिगुच्यते ॥

1.13.s:
brahmakṣatriyavaiśyānāṃ śuśrūṣuḥ śūdra ucyate |
karṣako vṛṣalo jñeya itare caiva dasyavaḥ ||
1.13.d:
ब्रह्मक्षत्रियवैश्यानां शुश्रूषुः शूद्र उच्यते ।
कर्षको वृषलो ज्ञेय इतरे चैव दस्यवः ॥
1.13.m: One who buys and sells grain and other goods is a vaiśya; any other is called a merchant. / One who is eager to serve brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, and vaiśyas is called a śūdra.

1.13.s:
sarvo hyuṣaḥ prāṅmukhaśca cintayed devapūrvakān |
dharmānarthāṃśca tatkleśānāyaṃ ca vyayameva ca ||
1.13.d:
सर्वो ह्युषः प्राङ्मुखश्च चिन्तयेद् देवपूर्वकान् ।
धर्मानर्थांश्च तत्क्लेशानायं च व्ययमेव च ॥
1.13.m: Dharma and wealth, the afflictions involved in them, income and expenditure, / lifespan, enmity, death, sin, and likewise good fortune,

1.13.s:
āyurdveṣaśca maraṇaṃ pāpaṃ bhāgyaṃ tathaiva ca |
vyādhiḥ puṣṭistathā śaktiḥ prātarutthānadikphalam ||
1.13.d:
आयुर्द्वेषश्च मरणं पापं भाग्यं तथैव च ।
व्याधिः पुष्टिस्तथा शक्तिः प्रातरुत्थानदिक्फलम् ॥
1.13.m: Disease, nourishment, power, and the fruit of the direction in rising in the morning. / The last watch of the night is known as dawn; half of that watch is called the twilight junction.

1.13.s:
niśāntyayāmoṣā jñeyā yāmārdhaṃ sandhirucyate |
tatkāle tu samutthāya viṇmūtre visṛjed dvijaḥ ||
1.13.d:
निशान्त्ययामोषा ज्ञेया यामार्धं सन्धिरुच्यते ।
तत्काले तु समुत्थाय विण्मूत्रे विसृजेद् द्विजः ॥
1.13.m: Rising at that time, a twice-born should discharge feces and urine. / Going far from the house, covered on the outside,

1.13.s:
gṛhād dūraṃ tato gatvā bāhyataḥ prāvṛtastathā |
udaṅmukhaḥ samāviśya pratibandhe'nyadiṅmukhaḥ ||
1.13.d:
गृहाद् दूरं ततो गत्वा बाह्यतः प्रावृतस्तथा ।
उदङ्मुखः समाविश्य प्रतिबन्धेऽन्यदिङ्मुखः ॥

1.13.s:
jalāgnibrāhmaṇādīnāṃ devānāṃ nābhimukhyataḥ |
liṅgaṃ pidhāya vāmena mukhamanyena pāṇinā ||
1.13.d:
जलाग्निब्राह्मणादीनां देवानां नाभिमुख्यतः ।
लिङ्गं पिधाय वामेन मुखमन्येन पाणिना ॥
1.13.m: He should sit facing north, or facing another direction if obstructed, / but not facing water, fire, brāhmaṇas, or the gods.

1.13.s:
malamutsṛjya cotthāya na paśyeccaiva tanmalam |
uddhṛtena jalenaiva śaucaṃ kuryājjalād bahiḥ ||
1.13.d:
मलमुत्सृज्य चोत्थाय न पश्येच्चैव तन्मलम् ।
उद्धृतेन जलेनैव शौचं कुर्याज्जलाद् बहिः ॥
1.13.m:
Covering the penis with the left hand and the mouth with the other, / having discharged the waste and stood up, he should not look back at that waste.
He should perform purification away from the water only with water drawn out, / or without descending into the sacred fords of gods, ancestors, or ṛṣis.

1.13.s:
athavā devapitrarṣitīrthāvataraṇaṃ vinā |
sapta vā pañca vā trīnvā gudaṃ saṃśodhayenmṛdā ||
1.13.d:
अथवा देवपित्रर्षितीर्थावतरणं विना ।
सप्त वा पञ्च वा त्रीन्वा गुदं संशोधयेन्मृदा ॥
1.13.m: He should cleanse the anus with clay seven, five, or three times. / The amount [of clay] for the penis is measured as a karkoṭa fruit, and for the anus, a handful is prescribed.

1.13.s:
liṅge karkoṭamātraṃ tu gude prasṛtiriṣyate |
tata utthāya paddhastaśaucaṃ gaṇḍūṣamaṣṭakam ||
1.13.d:
लिङ्गे कर्कोटमात्रं तु गुदे प्रसृतिरिष्यते ।
तत उत्थाय पद्धस्तशौचं गण्डूषमष्टकम् ॥
1.13.m: Then, having stood up, washing of the feet and hands and eight mouthfuls of water [for rinsing], / and cleaning the teeth with any leaf or twig outside the water,

1.13.s:
yena kena ca patreṇa kāṣṭhena ca jalād bahiḥ |
kāryaṃ santarjanīṃ tyajya dantadhāvanamīritam ||
1.13.d:
येन केन च पत्रेण काष्ठेन च जलाद् बहिः ।
कार्यं सन्तर्जनीं त्यज्य दन्तधावनमीरितम् ॥

1.13.s:
jaladevānnamaskṛtya mantreṇa snānamācaret |
aśaktaḥ kaṇṭhadaghnaṃ vā kaṭidaghnamathāpi vā ||
1.13.d:
जलदेवान्नमस्कृत्य मन्त्रेण स्नानमाचरेत् ।
अशक्तः कण्ठदघ्नं वा कटिदघ्नमथापि वा ॥

1.13.s:
ājānujalamāviśya mantrasthānaṃ samācaret |
devādīṃstarpayedvidvāṃstatra tīrthajalena ca ||
1.13.d:
आजानुजलमाविश्य मन्त्रस्थानं समाचरेत् ।
देवादींस्तर्पयेद्विद्वांस्तत्र तीर्थजलेन च ॥
1.13.m: A wise man should offer libations to the gods and others there with the water of the sacred ford. / Taking a washed cloth, he should wear it with five tucks.

1.13.s:
dhautavastraṃ samādāya pañcakacchena dhārayet |
uttarīyaṃ ca kiñcaiva dhāryaṃ sarveṣu karmasu ||
1.13.d:
धौतवस्त्रं समादाय पञ्चकच्छेन धारयेत् ।
उत्तरीयं च किञ्चैव धार्यं सर्वेषु कर्मसु ॥

1.13.s:
nadyāditīrthasnane tu snānavastraṃ na śodhayet |
vāpīkūpagṛhādau tu snānādūrdhvaṃ nayedbudhaḥ ||
1.13.d:
नद्यादितीर्थस्नने तु स्नानवस्त्रं न शोधयेत् ।
वापीकूपगृहादौ तु स्नानादूर्ध्वं नयेद्बुधः ॥
1.13.m:
An upper garment must also be worn in all rites. / When bathing in a sacred ford such as a river, however, he should not wash the bathing garment [in that water].
At a stepwell, well, or house, the wise man should take it away after bathing. / On a stone, wood, or on water or ground,

1.13.s:
śilādārvādike vāpi jale vāpi sthale'pi vā |
saṃśodhya pīḍayedvastraṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptaye dvijāḥ ||
1.13.d:
शिलादार्वादिके वापि जले वापि स्थलेऽपि वा ।
संशोध्य पीडयेद्वस्त्रं पितॄणां तृप्तये द्विजाः ॥

1.13.s:
jābālakoktamantreṇa bhasmanā ca tripuṇḍrakam |
anyathā cejjale pātastato narakamṛcchati ||
1.13.d:
जाबालकोक्तमन्त्रेण भस्मना च त्रिपुण्ड्रकम् ।
अन्यथा चेज्जले पातस्ततो नरकमृच्छति ॥

1.13.s:
āpohiṣṭheti śirasi prokṣayetpāpaśāntaye |
yasyeti mantraṃ pāde tu sandhiprokṣaṇamucyate ||
1.13.d:
आपोहिष्ठेति शिरसि प्रोक्षयेत्पापशान्तये ।
यस्येति मन्त्रं पादे तु सन्धिप्रोक्षणमुच्यते ॥

1.13.s:
hṛdaye mūrdhni pāde ca mūrdhni hṛtpāda eva ca |
hṛtpādamūrdhni samprokṣya mantrasnānaṃ vidurbudhāḥ ||
1.13.d:
हृदये मूर्ध्नि पादे च मूर्ध्नि हृत्पाद एव च ।
हृत्पादमूर्ध्नि सम्प्रोक्ष्य मन्त्रस्नानं विदुर्बुधाः ॥

1.13.s:
īṣatsparśe ca doḥsvāsthye rājarāṣṭrabhaye'pi ca |
agatyā gatikāle ca mantrasnānaṃ samācaret ||
1.13.d:
ईषत्स्पर्शे च दोःस्वास्थ्ये राजराष्ट्रभयेऽपि च ।
अगत्या गतिकाले च मन्त्रस्नानं समाचरेत् ॥

1.13.s:
prātaḥ sūryānuvākena sāyamagnyanuvākataḥ |
apaḥ pītvā tathā madhye punaḥ prokṣaṇamācaret ||
1.13.d:
प्रातः सूर्यानुवाकेन सायमग्न्यनुवाकतः ।
अपः पीत्वा तथा मध्ये पुनः प्रोक्षणमाचरेत् ॥
1.13.m: Having sipped water, he should perform the sprinkling again in between. / At the end of chanting the mantra with the Gāyatrī, he should cast the water upward towards the east.

1.13.s:
gāyatryā japamantrānte trirūrdhvaṃ prāgvinikṣipet |
mantreṇa saha caikaṃ vai madhye'rghyaṃ tu raverdvijāḥ ||
1.13.d:
गायत्र्या जपमन्त्रान्ते त्रिरूर्ध्वं प्राग्विनिक्षिपेत् ।
मन्त्रेण सह चैकं वै मध्येऽर्घ्यं तु रवेर्द्विजाः ॥

1.13.s:
atha jāte ca sāyāhne bhuvi paścimadiṅmukhaḥ |
uddhṛtya dadyāt prātastu madhyāhne'ṅgulibhistathā ||
1.13.d:
अथ जाते च सायाह्ने भुवि पश्चिमदिङ्मुखः ।
उद्धृत्य दद्यात् प्रातस्तु मध्याह्नेऽङ्गुलिभिस्तथा ॥

1.13.s:
aṅgulīnāṃ ca randhreṇa lambaṃ paśyed divākaram |
ātmapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā śuddhācamanamācaret ||
1.13.d:
अङ्गुलीनां च रन्ध्रेण लम्बं पश्येद् दिवाकरम् ।
आत्मप्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा शुद्धाचमनमाचरेत् ॥

1.13.s:
sāyaṃ muhūrtādarvāktu kṛtā sandhyā vṛthā bhavet |
akālātkāla ityukto dine'tīte yathākramam ||
1.13.d:
सायं मुहूर्तादर्वाक्तु कृता सन्ध्या वृथा भवेत् ।
अकालात्काल इत्युक्तो दिनेऽतीते यथाक्रमम् ॥

1.13.s:
divātīte ca gāyatrīṃ śataṃ nitye kramājjapet |
ādaśāhātparātītaṃ gāyatrīṃ lakṣamabhyaset ||
1.13.d:
दिवातीते च गायत्रीं शतं नित्ये क्रमाज्जपेत् ।
आदशाहात्परातीतं गायत्रीं लक्षमभ्यसेत् ॥

1.13.s:
māsātīte tu nitye hi punaścopanayaṃ caret |
īśo gaurī guho viṣṇurbrahmā candraśca vai yamaḥ ||
1.13.d:
मासातीते तु नित्ये हि पुनश्चोपनयं चरेत् ।
ईशो गौरी गुहो विष्णुर्ब्रह्मा चन्द्रश्च वै यमः ॥

1.13.s:
evaṃrūpāṃśca vai devāṃstarpayedarthasiddhaye |
brahmārpaṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā śuddhācamanamācaret ||
1.13.d:
एवंरूपांश्च वै देवांस्तर्पयेदर्थसिद्धये ।
ब्रह्मार्पणं ततः कृत्वा शुद्धाचमनमाचरेत् ॥
1.13.m:
To Śiva, Gaurī, Guha, Viṣṇu, Brahmā, Indra, and Yama— / to gods having such forms he should offer libations for the attainment of his goals.
Then, having dedicated it to Brahman, he should perform pure sipping of water. / To the south of the sacred ford, in an auspicious monastery or temple, the wise man,

1.13.s:
tīrthadakṣiṇataḥ śaste maṭhe mantrālaye budhaḥ |
tatra devālaye vāpi gṛhe vā niyatasthale ||
1.13.d:
तीर्थदक्षिणतः शस्ते मठे मन्त्रालये बुधः ।
तत्र देवालये वापि गृहे वा नियतस्थले ॥

1.13.s:
sarvāndevānnamaskṛtya sthirabuddhiḥ sthirāsanaḥ |
praṇavaṃ pūrvamabhyasya gāyatrīmabhyasettataḥ ||
1.13.d:
सर्वान्देवान्नमस्कृत्य स्थिरबुद्धिः स्थिरासनः ।
प्रणवं पूर्वमभ्यस्य गायत्रीमभ्यसेत्ततः ॥
1.13.m:
Or in a temple there, or at home in a fixed place, / having bowed to all the gods, with a steady intellect and a steady seat,
Having first practiced the syllable Oṃ, should then practice the Gāyatrī. / Understanding the identity of the individual soul and Brahman, he should practice the syllable Oṃ.

1.13.s:
jīvabrahmaikyaviṣayaṃ buddhvā praṇavamabhyaset |
trailokyasṛṣṭikartāraṃ sthitikartāramacyutam ||
1.13.d:
जीवब्रह्मैक्यविषयं बुद्ध्वा प्रणवमभ्यसेत् ।
त्रैलोक्यसृष्टिकर्तारं स्थितिकर्तारमच्युतम् ॥
1.13.m: We worship the creator of the three worlds, Acyuta the sustainer, / and Rudra the destroyer, who is self-luminous.

1.13.s:
saṃhartāraṃ tathā rudraṃ svaprakāśamupāsmahe |
jñānakarmendriyāṇāṃ ca manovṛttīrdhiyastathā ||
1.13.d:
संहर्तारं तथा रुद्रं स्वप्रकाशमुपास्महे ।
ज्ञानकर्मेन्द्रियाणां च मनोवृत्तीर्धियस्तथा ॥

1.13.s:
bhogamokṣaprade dharme jñāne ca prerayetsadā |
itthamarthaṃ dhiyā dhyāyanbrahma prāpnoti niścayam ||
1.13.d:
भोगमोक्षप्रदे धर्मे ज्ञाने च प्रेरयेत्सदा ।
इत्थमर्थं धिया ध्यायन्ब्रह्म प्राप्नोति निश्चयम् ॥
1.13.m:
May he always impel the organs of knowledge and action, the mental modifications, and the intellect / toward dharma that grants enjoyment and liberation, and toward knowledge.
Meditating with the intellect on the meaning in this way, he undoubtedly attains Brahman. / Or he should repeat it solely for the fulfillment of his status as a brāhmaṇa every day.

1.13.s:
kevalaṃ vā japennityaṃ brāhmaṇyasya ca pūrtaye |
sahasramabhyasennityaṃ prātarbrāhmaṇapuṅgavaḥ ||
1.13.d:
केवलं वा जपेन्नित्यं ब्राह्मण्यस्य च पूर्तये ।
सहस्रमभ्यसेन्नित्यं प्रातर्ब्राह्मणपुङ्गवः ॥

1.13.s:
anyeṣāṃ ca yathāśakti madhyāhne ca śataṃ japet |
sāyaṃ dvidaśakaṃ jñeyaṃ śikhāṣṭakasamanvitam ||
1.13.d:
अन्येषां च यथाशक्ति मध्याह्ने च शतं जपेत् ।
सायं द्विदशकं ज्ञेयं शिखाष्टकसमन्वितम् ॥
1.13.m:
An eminent brāhmaṇa should recite a thousand repetitions daily in the morning; / others according to their capacity; and at midday, he should repeat a hundred.
In the evening, twenty should be known, together with eight for the crest-lock. / Beginning from the mūlādhāra up to those dwelling in the dvādaśānta:

1.13.s:
mūlādhāraṃ samārabhya dvādaśāṃśasthitāṃstathā |
vidyeśabrahmaviṣṇvīśajīvātmaparameśvarān ||
1.13.d:
मूलाधारं समारभ्य द्वादशांशस्थितांस्तथा ।
विद्येशब्रह्मविष्ण्वीशजीवात्मपरमेश्वरान् ॥
1.13.m: The lords of knowledge, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Īśa, the individual soul, and the Supreme Lord; / with the consciousness of Brahman and their identity, he should repeat [the mantra] with the contemplation “I am He”.

1.13.s:
brahmabuddhyā tadaikyaṃ ca so'haṃ bhāvanayā japet |
tāneva brahmarandhrādau kāyād bāhye ca bhāvayet ||
1.13.d:
ब्रह्मबुद्ध्या तदैक्यं च सोऽहं भावनया जपेत् ।
तानेव ब्रह्मरन्ध्रादौ कायाद् बाह्ये च भावयेत् ॥

1.13.s:
mahattattvaṃ samārabhya śarīraṃ tu sahasrakam |
ekaikasmājjapādekamatikramya śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||
1.13.d:
महत्तत्त्वं समारभ्य शरीरं तु सहस्रकम् ।
एकैकस्माज्जपादेकमतिक्रम्य शनैः शनैः ॥
1.13.m:
He should meditate on those very entities in the aperture of Brahman and outside the body. / Beginning with the great principle up to the thousand[-petaled lotus] in the body,
Transcending one by one gradually from each repetition, / he should unite the individual soul with the Supreme; this is declared to be the reality of repetition.

1.13.s:
parasminyojayejjīvaṃ japatattvamudāhṛtam |
śatadvidaśakaṃ dehaṃ śikhāṣṭakasamanvitam ||
1.13.d:
परस्मिन्योजयेज्जीवं जपतत्त्वमुदाहृतम् ।
शतद्विदशकं देहं शिखाष्टकसमन्वितम् ॥

1.13.s:
mantrāṇāṃ japa evaṃ hi japamādikramādviduḥ |
sahasraṃ brāhmadaṃ vidyācchatamaindrapradaṃ viduḥ ||
1.13.d:
मन्त्राणां जप एवं हि जपमादिक्रमाद्विदुः ।
सहस्रं ब्राह्मदं विद्याच्छतमैन्द्रप्रदं विदुः ॥

1.13.s:
itarattvātmarakṣārthaṃ brahmayoniṣu jāyate |
divākaramupasthāya nityamitthaṃ samācaret ||
1.13.d:
इतरत्त्वात्मरक्षार्थं ब्रह्मयोनिषु जायते ।
दिवाकरमुपस्थाय नित्यमित्थं समाचरेत् ॥
1.13.m: A thousand is known to bestow Brahman; a hundred is known to bestow the realm of Indra; / another [lesser count] is for self-protection, and he is born in brāhmaṇa wombs.

1.13.s:
lakṣadvādaśayuktastu pūrṇabrāhmaṇa īritaḥ |
gāyatryā lakṣahīnaṃ tu vedakārye na yojayet ||
1.13.d:
लक्षद्वादशयुक्तस्तु पूर्णब्राह्मण ईरितः ।
गायत्र्या लक्षहीनं तु वेदकार्ये न योजयेत् ॥

1.13.s:
āsaptatestu niyamaṃ paścātpravrājanaṃ caret |
prātardvādaśasāhasraṃ pravrājī praṇavaṃ japet ||
1.13.d:
आसप्ततेस्तु नियमं पश्चात्प्रव्राजनं चरेत् ।
प्रातर्द्वादशसाहस्रं प्रव्राजी प्रणवं जपेत् ॥
1.13.m:
One lacking a hundred thousand repetitions of the Gāyatrī should not be employed in Vedic rites. / He should observe this discipline until seventy, and thereafter enter the wandering ascetic life.
A wandering ascetic should repeat the syllable Oṃ twelve thousand times in the morning. / As days pass, he should repeat it thus daily in order.

1.13.s:
dine dine tvatikrānte nityamevaṃ kramājjapet |
māsādau kramaśo'tīte sārdhalakṣajapena hi ||
1.13.d:
दिने दिने त्वतिक्रान्ते नित्यमेवं क्रमाज्जपेत् ।
मासादौ क्रमशोऽतीते सार्धलक्षजपेन हि ॥

1.13.s:
ata ūrdhvamatikrānte punaḥ praiṣaṃ samācaret |
evaṃ kṛtvā doṣaśāntiranyathā rauravaṃ vrajet ||
1.13.d:
अत ऊर्ध्वमतिक्रान्ते पुनः प्रैषं समाचरेत् ।
एवं कृत्वा दोषशान्तिरन्यथा रौरवं व्रजेत् ॥

1.13.s:
dharmārthayostato yatnaṃ kuryātkāmī na cetaraḥ |
brāhmaṇo muktikāmaḥ syād bahmajñānaṃ sadābhyaset ||
1.13.d:
धर्मार्थयोस्ततो यत्नं कुर्यात्कामी न चेतरः ।
ब्राह्मणो मुक्तिकामः स्याद् बह्मज्ञानं सदाभ्यसेत् ॥
1.13.m: Having done this, there is expiation of fault; otherwise, he goes to the Raurava hell. / Thereafter, one who has worldly desires should strive for dharma and wealth, but not one who is other than that.

1.13.s:
dharmādartho'rthato bhogo bhogādvairāgyasambhavaḥ |
dharmārjitārthabhogena vairāgyamupajāyate ||
1.13.d:
धर्मादर्थोऽर्थतो भोगो भोगाद्वैराग्यसम्भवः ।
धर्मार्जितार्थभोगेन वैराग्यमुपजायते ॥
1.13.m:
A brāhmaṇa desiring liberation should always practice knowledge of Brahman. / From dharma comes wealth, from wealth enjoyment, and from enjoyment the arising of dispassion.
Through enjoyment of wealth earned by dharma, dispassion arises; / through enjoyment of contrary wealth, passion alone is born.

1.13.s:
viparītārthabhogena rāga eva prajāyate |
dharmaśca dvividhaḥ prokto dravyadehadvayena ca ||
1.13.d:
विपरीतार्थभोगेन राग एव प्रजायते ।
धर्मश्च द्विविधः प्रोक्तो द्रव्यदेहद्वयेन च ॥
1.13.m: And dharma is declared to be of two kinds: by means of substance and body. / The substantial would be in the form of sacrifices and the like, while bathing at sacred fords and so on is bodily.

1.13.s:
dravyamijyādirūpaṃ syāttīrthasnānādi daihikam |
dharmeṇa dhanamāpnoti tapasā divyarūpatām ||
1.13.d:
द्रव्यमिज्यादिरूपं स्यात्तीर्थस्नानादि दैहिकम् ।
धर्मेण धनमाप्नोति तपसा दिव्यरूपताम् ॥

1.13.s:
niṣkāmaḥ śuddhimāpnoti śuddhyā jñānaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
kṛtādau hi tapaḥ ślāghyaṃ dravyadharmaḥ kalau yuge ||
1.13.d:
निष्कामः शुद्धिमाप्नोति शुद्ध्या ज्ञानं न संशयः ।
कृतादौ हि तपः श्लाघ्यं द्रव्यधर्मः कलौ युगे ॥
1.13.m: Through wealth, one attains wealth; through asceticism, a divine form. / One free from desire attains purity; through purity comes knowledge, without a doubt.

1.13.s:
kṛte dhyānājjñānasiddhistretāyāṃ tapasā tathā |
dvāpare yajanājjñānaṃ pratimāpūjayā kalau ||
1.13.d:
कृते ध्यानाज्ज्ञानसिद्धिस्त्रेतायां तपसा तथा ।
द्वापरे यजनाज्ज्ञानं प्रतिमापूजया कलौ ॥
1.13.m: In the Kṛta and other ages asceticism is praiseworthy, while in the Kali age, substantial dharma [is so]. / In the Kṛta, the perfection of knowledge comes from meditation; in the Tretā, likewise, through asceticism;

1.13.s:
yādṛśaṃ puṇyapāpaṃ vā tādṛśaṃ phalameva hi |
dravyadehāṅgabhedena nyūnavṛddhikṣayādikam ||
1.13.d:
यादृशं पुण्यपापं वा तादृशं फलमेव हि ।
द्रव्यदेहाङ्गभेदेन न्यूनवृद्धिक्षयादिकम् ॥

1.13.s:
adharmo hiṃsikārūpo dharmastu sukharūpakaḥ |
adharmād duḥkhamāpnoti dharmādvai sukhamedhate ||
1.13.d:
